/* ── Mini modal ── */
.mini-modal-trigger {
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-decoration-style: dotted;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
    text-decoration-color: #9ca3af;
}
.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; }
.mini-modal {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.2rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 4px 6px 14px 0 rgba(42, 31, 65, 0.16);
    z-index: 100;
    width: 3.2rem;
    max-width: 3.2rem;
}
.mini-modal--open { display: block; }
.mini-modal__title {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #25224a;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
    white-space: normal;
    text-transform: none;
}
.mini-modal__text {
    font-weight: 400;
    font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-transform: none;
    white-space: break-spaces;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0.1rem;
    right: 0.1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0.04rem;
    line-height: 1;
    font-size: 0.16rem;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close:hover { color: #25224a; }
.mini-modal__link {
    display: inline;
    color: #3e50f7;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: 500;
}
.mini-modal__link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.mini-modal-bg {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    z-index: 99;
}
.mini-modal-bg--open { display: block; }
/* Hero labels — white text needs white dotted underline */
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger { text-decoration-color: rgba(164, 161, 203, 0.5); }
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger:hover,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: #a4a1cb; }
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger .mini-modal,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger .mini-modal { white-space: normal; }

/* ── Shake animation ── */
.shaker {
    animation: shake 1s cubic-bezier(0.36, 0.07, 0.19, 0.97) both;
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    backface-visibility: hidden;
    perspective: 1000px;
}
@keyframes shake {
    10%, 90% { transform: translate3d(-1px, 0, 0); }
    20%, 80% { transform: translate3d(2px, 0, 0); }
    30%, 50%, 70% { transform: translate3d(-4px, 0, 0); }
    40%, 60% { transform: translate3d(4px, 0, 0); }
}
.section__blur, .sidebar-section__blur { cursor: pointer; }

                    <div class="expandable-text with-margin-bottom">
        <div class="listing-desc listing-desc--truncated" id="desc-main">This is a fast-growing speech therapy platform helping parents build children’s language skills through expert-designed, play-based lessons. Engaging activities, progress tracking, and step-by-step guidance turn screen time into real developmental gains.

Bootstrapped and subscription-based, it serves 5,000+ customers with ~$300k ARR. With 974% YoY growth and $28,135 revenue / $24,017 profit last month, it’s primed to scale via focused marketing and pricing.

✅ 5,000+ customers; ~$300k ARR; 974% YoY growth
✅ TTM revenue $350k; TTM profit $43,384; last month $28,135 revenue / $24,017 profit
✅ Play-based curriculum created by experts; high parent satisfaction
✅ B2C subscription with clear upsell and bundling opportunities
✅ Lean operations, small team, low overhead; ready to scale
✅ Upside: improve conversion, increase pricing, SEO, content, paid + social, new features, new markets
✅ Cross-platform app for fast iteration and lower costs
✅ Selling due to lack of time</div>

    <script>
function toggleNavMenu() {
    var dd = document.getElementById('nav-menu-dropdown');
    dd.classList.toggle('nav-menu-dropdown--open');
}
document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var wrapper = document.querySelector('.nav-menu-wrapper');
    var dd = document.getElementById('nav-menu-dropdown');
    if (wrapper && dd && !wrapper.contains(e.target)) {
        dd.classList.remove('nav-menu-dropdown--open');
    }
});
function toggleDesc(id, btn) {
    var desc = document.getElementById(id);
    var expanded = btn.classList.contains('expanded');
    var textNode = btn.firstChild;
    if (expanded) {
        desc.classList.add('listing-desc--truncated');
        btn.classList.remove('expanded');
        textNode.textContent = 'See more ';
    } else {
        desc.classList.remove('listing-desc--truncated');
        btn.classList.add('expanded');
        textNode.textContent = 'See less ';
    }
}
var activeMiniModal = null;
var miniModalBg = null;
function openMiniModal(trigger) {
    closeMiniModal();
    var modal = trigger.querySelector('.mini-modal');
    if (!modal) return;
    if (window.innerWidth > 1024) {
        var rect = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
        modal.style.top = (rect.bottom + 8) + 'px';
        modal.style.left = rect.left + 'px';
    } else {
        modal.style.top = '';
        modal.style.left = '';
    }
    modal.classList.add('mini-modal--open');
    activeMiniModal = modal;
    if (!miniModalBg) {
        miniModalBg = document.createElement('div');
        miniModalBg.className = 'mini-modal-bg';
        miniModalBg.addEventListener('click', function () { closeMiniModal(); });
        document.body.appendChild(miniModalBg);
    }
    miniModalBg.classList.add('mini-modal-bg--open');
}
function closeMiniModal(e) {
    if (e) { e.stopPropagation(); }
    if (activeMiniModal) {
        activeMiniModal.classList.remove('mini-modal--open');
        activeMiniModal = null;
    }
    if (miniModalBg) { miniModalBg.classList.remove('mini-modal-bg--open'); }
}
function scrollToCtaAndShake() {
    var cta = document.querySelector('.cta-card');
    if (!cta) return;
    var rect = cta.getBoundingClientRect();
    var scrollTop = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
    window.scrollTo({ top: rect.top + scrollTop - 100, behavior: 'smooth' });
    setTimeout(function () {
        cta.classList.add('shaker');
        setTimeout(function () { cta.classList.remove('shaker'); }, 1000);
    }, 400);
}
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-expandable]').forEach(function (btn) {
        var id = btn.getAttribute('data-expandable');
        var desc = document.getElementById(id);
        if (desc && desc.scrollHeight <= desc.clientHeight) {
            btn.style.display = 'none';
        }
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.section__blur, .sidebar-section__blur').forEach(function (el) {
        el.addEventListener('click', scrollToCtaAndShake);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.mini-modal-trigger').forEach(function (trigger) {
        trigger.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            if (activeMiniModal && activeMiniModal.parentElement === trigger) {
                closeMiniModal();
            } else {
                openMiniModal(trigger);
            }
        });
    });
});

/* ── Mini modal ── */
.mini-modal-trigger {
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-decoration-style: dotted;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
    text-decoration-color: #9ca3af;
}
.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; }
.mini-modal {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.2rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 4px 6px 14px 0 rgba(42, 31, 65, 0.16);
    z-index: 100;
    width: 3.2rem;
    max-width: 3.2rem;
}
.mini-modal--open { display: block; }
.mini-modal__title {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #25224a;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
    white-space: normal;
    text-transform: none;
}
.mini-modal__text {
    font-weight: 400;
    font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-transform: none;
    white-space: break-spaces;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0.1rem;
    right: 0.1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0.04rem;
    line-height: 1;
    font-size: 0.16rem;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close:hover { color: #25224a; }
.mini-modal__link {
    display: inline;
    color: #3e50f7;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: 500;
}
.mini-modal__link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.mini-modal-bg {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    z-index: 99;
}
.mini-modal-bg--open { display: block; }
/* Hero labels — white text needs white dotted underline */
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger { text-decoration-color: rgba(164, 161, 203, 0.5); }
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger:hover,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: #a4a1cb; }
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger .mini-modal,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger .mini-modal { white-space: normal; }

/* ── Shake animation ── */
.shaker {
    animation: shake 1s cubic-bezier(0.36, 0.07, 0.19, 0.97) both;
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    backface-visibility: hidden;
    perspective: 1000px;
}
@keyframes shake {
    10%, 90% { transform: translate3d(-1px, 0, 0); }
    20%, 80% { transform: translate3d(2px, 0, 0); }
    30%, 50%, 70% { transform: translate3d(-4px, 0, 0); }
    40%, 60% { transform: translate3d(4px, 0, 0); }
}
.section__blur, .sidebar-section__blur { cursor: pointer; }

Bootstrapped, profitable, and running lean since 2021, the business serves 1,000–5,000 users across B2B and B2C with a freemium-to-subscription model. Products are open-source friendly, well rated, and integrate seamlessly with WordPress and WooCommerce.

✅ Clear levers: SEO, content, new features, digital marketing

✅ Attractive entry price of $29,340 for a proven plugin portfolio</div>

body { padding-top: 0.72rem; }
.header a.header__logo-link { display: flex; }
.header__logo { height: 0.305rem; }
.header__right-side { display: flex; align-items: center; }
.header__free-saas { font-size: 0.14rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; }

.nav-menu-wrapper { position: relative; margin-left: 0.16rem; }
.nav-menu-btn {
    display: flex;

    justify-content: center;

    height: 0.37rem;

}

.nav-menu-btn svg:first-child { width: 0.12rem; height: 0.07rem; }
.nav-menu-btn svg:last-child { width: 0.23rem; height: 0.23rem; }
.nav-menu-dropdown {
    display: none;
    position: absolute;
    top: calc(100% + 0.08rem);
    right: 0;
    width: 2rem;
    border-radius: 0 0.1rem 0.1rem 0.1rem;
    box-shadow: 0.04rem 0.06rem 0.08rem 0 rgba(42,31,65,0.56);
    background: #fff;
    z-index: 200;
    overflow: hidden;
}
.nav-menu-dropdown--open { display: block; }
.nav-menu-dropdown__section {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: 0.1rem 0 0.12rem;
}
.nav-menu-dropdown__section:first-child { border-bottom: 1px solid #a8a7b7; }
.nav-menu-dropdown__item {
    display: block;
    padding: 0.08rem 0.23rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    color: #6b7280;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: background 0.3s;
}
.nav-menu-dropdown__item--primary { color: #25224a; font-weight: 500; }
.nav-menu-dropdown__item:hover { background: #f5f4f8; }

/* ── Container ── */
.container { max-width: 15.6rem; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0.24rem 0.72rem 0.72rem; }

/* ── Hero ── */
.hero {
    background: linear-gradient(45deg, #1e1b3b 40%, #2f2b6d 60%);
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    padding: 0.4rem;
    color: #fff;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}
.hero__top { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; }
.hero__category { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.08rem; }
.hero__category-text { font-size: 0.12rem; color: #a4a1cb; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.3px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.04rem; }
.hero__category-text svg { width: 0.18rem; height: 0.18rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.hero__category-text a { color: #a4a1cb; text-decoration: underline; }
.hero__location { font-size: 0.12rem; line-height: 0.18rem; color: #a4a1cb; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.3px; margin-left: 0.16rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.04rem; }
.hero__location svg { width: 0.18rem; height: 0.18rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.hero__name-blocker {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.1rem;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #3c377f 10%, #6b63e5 70%, #3c377f 100%);
    border: 1px solid #4b45a0;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    padding: 0.12rem 0.52rem;
    margin: 0.16rem auto;
}
.hero__name-blocker svg { width: 0.16rem; height: 0.16rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.hero__name-blocker span { font-size: 0.14rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 0.24rem; color: #fff; }
.hero__headline {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.24rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: #a4a1cb;
    text-align: center;
    max-width: 5.72rem;
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
}
.hero__badges { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 0.04rem; margin-top: 0.16rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.badge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.04rem;
    background: #27245b;
    border: 1px solid #4b45a0;
    padding: .08rem .12rem;
    border-radius: .9rem;       
    font-size: 0.12rem;
    line-height: 0.18rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #fff;
}
.badge svg { width: 0.16rem; height: 0.16rem; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* ── Hero bottom: metrics + CTA ── */
.hero__bottom { display: flex; gap: 0.4rem; margin-top: 0.32rem; }

/* ── Metrics column ── */
.metrics-col { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.metrics-card {
    background: #3c377f;
    border-radius: 0.1rem;
    border: 1px solid #4b45a0;
    padding: 0.3rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.1rem;
}
.metrics-card:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.metrics-card__row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; }
.metrics-card__divider { width: 1px; align-self: stretch; background: #4b45a0; margin: 0 0.2rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.metrics-card__label { font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 700; color: #a4a1cb; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-bottom: 0.08rem; white-space: nowrap; }
.metrics-card__value { font-size: 0.18rem; line-height: 0.24rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; white-space: nowrap; }

/* Revenue bars */
.rev-row { margin-bottom: 0.38rem; }
.rev-row:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.rev-header { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; margin-bottom: 0.12rem; }
.rev-header__col { width: 1.4rem; margin-right: 0.25rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.rev-header__label { font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; color: #a4a1cb; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-bottom: 0.06rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.06rem; }
.rev-header__label::before { content: ""; display: inline-block; width: 0.08rem; height: 0.08rem; border-radius: 0.02rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.rev-header__label--revenue::before { background: #5650AC; }
.rev-header__label--profit-ttm::before { background: #7EDC72; }
.rev-header__label--profit-lm::before { background: #72BCDC; }
.rev-header__value { font-size: 0.2rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; line-height: 1.2; white-space: nowrap; }
.rev-bar {
    height: 0.1rem;
    border-radius: 0.22rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    background:
        repeating-linear-gradient(
            135deg,
            #5650AC 0 .28rem,
            #4B4696 0 .33rem
        ) 0 / 100%;
}
.rev-bar__fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 0.22rem; }

/* ── CTA column (hero) ── */
.cta-col { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.cta-card {
    border: 1px dashed #6b66b6;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    background: linear-gradient(45deg, #2F2B6D 60%, #1E1B3B 100%);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;
    height: 100%;
    padding: 0 1.06rem;
    width: 5.88rem;
    height: 3.42rem;
}
.cta-card__icon { display: flex; height: 0.3rem; margin-bottom: 0.26rem; }
.cta-card__title { font-size: 0.18rem; line-height: 0.24rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 11px; }
.cta-card__desc { font-size: 0.16rem; color: #a4a1cb; margin-bottom: 0.28rem; line-height: 0.24rem; }
.cta-card__btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    width: 2.54rem;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.08rem;
    padding: 0.16rem 0.26rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 0 0.09rem 0.09rem;
    font-size: 0.13rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #000;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: opacity 0.2s;
}
.cta-card__btn:hover { opacity: 0.85; text-decoration: none; }

/* ── Content area ── */
.content { display: flex; gap: 0.16rem; }
.content__left { 
    padding: 0.1rem; 
    flex: 5; 
    min-width: 0; 
    background: #fff; 
    border-radius: 0.09rem; 
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    max-width: 8rem;
}
.content__right { width: 4.76rem; }

/* ── Sections ── */
.section {
    padding: 0 0.3rem 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
.section__header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.09rem;
    padding: 0.2rem 0;
    margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
    border-bottom: 0.02rem solid #f0f0f5;
    background: #f5f7ff;
    border-radius: 0.06rem;
    padding: 0.3rem;
    margin: 0 -0.3rem 0.4rem;
    border-bottom: none;
}
.section__title { font-size: 0.16rem; line-height: 0.21rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; }
.section__updated { font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 500; color: #7f798d; margin-left: auto; }
.section__provider-logo { height: 0.26rem; width: auto; margin-left: 0.06rem; }
.section__category-badge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.06rem;
    font-size: 0.16rem;
    font-weight: 700;
}
.section__location { font-size: 0.14rem; color: #7f798d; margin-left: 0.12rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.04rem; }
.section__location svg { width: 0.14rem; height: 0.14rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.section__location svg path { fill: #7f798d; }
.section__blur {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 0 -0.32rem;
}
.section__blur img {
    width: 100%;
    display: block;
}

.listing-headline { font-size: 0.16rem; font-weight: 500; color: #25224a; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; line-height: 1.4; }
.listing-desc { font-size: 0.14rem; color: #464154; line-height: 0.22rem; white-space: pre-line; margin-bottom: 0.24rem; }
.listing-label { font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 700; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-bottom: 0.08rem; }
.listing-label__double-margin { margin-bottom: 0.16rem; }
.listing-value { font-size: 0.18rem; line-height: 0.24rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; }
.listing-value__underlined { border-bottom: 1px dotted #7F798D; }

.price-row { display: flex; gap: 0.7rem; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }

/* ── Performance ── */
.perf-grid { display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 0.7rem; }
.perf-item { text-align: left; }
.perf-label { width: fit-content; display: block; font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 600; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-bottom: 0.08rem; }
.perf-value { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.06rem; font-size: 0.14rem; line-height: 0.25rem; font-weight: 500; color: #25224a; }
.perf-value svg { width: 0.24rem; height: 0.24rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.perf-value__mobile { display: none; }

/* ── Expandable text wrapper ── */
.expandable-text {
    margin-top: 0.16rem;

    &.with-margin-bottom {
        margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    }
}
.expandable-text .listing-desc,
.expandable-text .company-field__value {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
.company-field .expandable-text {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* ── Truncated description with See more ── */
.listing-desc--truncated {
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    white-space: normal;
}
.see-more-link {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.04rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #1b1625;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin-top: 0.08rem;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 0.02rem;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0;
    font-family: inherit;
}
.see-more-link svg {
    transition: transform 0.2s ease;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}
.see-more-link.expanded svg {
    transform: rotate(180deg);
}

/* ── Price reduced badge ── */
.price-reduced-badge {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.06rem;
    padding: 0.06rem 0.12rem;
    border-radius: 0.04rem;
    border: 1px solid #3E50F7;
    background: #EEF2FE;           
    font-size: 0.1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #3E50F7;
    white-space: nowrap;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

/* ── Category icon card container ── */
.type-card__icon {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-width: 0.44rem;
    width: 0.44rem;
    height: 0.44rem;
    border-radius: 0.1rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    background: #fff;
}
.type-card__icon svg {
    width: 0.24rem;
    height: 0.24rem;
}

/* ── Annual snapshot table ── */
.annual-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
.annual-table th { font-size: 0.11rem; font-weight: 600; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: left; padding: 0.12rem 0.16rem; border-bottom: 0.02rem solid #f0f0f5; }
.annual-table td { font-size: 0.14rem; padding: 0.14rem 0.16rem; border-bottom: 0.01rem solid #f0f0f5; color: #25224a; }
.annual-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }

/* ── Blurred section (chart placeholder with lock) ── */
.blurred-section {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f0eef7, #e8e6f0);
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}
.blurred-section--chart {
    min-height: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.blurred-section--sidebar {
    min-height: 0.08rem;
}
.blurred-section::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(
        0deg,
        transparent,
        transparent 0.3rem,
        rgba(62, 80, 247, 0.03) 0.3rem,
        rgba(62, 80, 247, 0.03) 0.31rem
    );
    pointer-events: none;
}
.blurred-section svg {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* ── Metrics top row (customer metrics visible values) ── */
.metrics-top-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 0.2rem 0.3rem;
}
.metrics-top-item {
    position: relative;
    margin: 0 0 0.2rem;
    border-right: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
}
.metrics-top-item .listing-label {
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n),
.metrics-top-item:last-child {
    border-right: none;
}
/* Last row: no bottom margin (margin only separates rows). */
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):nth-last-child(-n + 4),
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):nth-last-child(-n + 4) ~ .metrics-top-item {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
/* Spacing below the grid only when the locked-chart blur follows it. */
.metrics-top-row + .section__blur {
    margin-top: 0.2rem;
}
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):not(:first-child)::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: -0.2rem;
    left: 0;
    width: calc(4 * 100% + 3 * 0.3rem);
    border-top: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
}
.metrics-top-value {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.08rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    color: #25224a;
}
.metrics-top-value svg { width: 0.24rem; height: 0.24rem; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* ── Bullet list ── */
.bullet-list {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.08rem;
}
.bullet-list li {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.1rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    color: #25224a;
    line-height: 1.5;
}
.bullet-list li::before {
    content: "";
    display: inline-block;
    width: 0.06rem;
    height: 0.06rem;
    min-width: 0.06rem;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #3e50f7;
    margin-top: 0.07rem;
}

/* ── Company field ── */
.companiey-fields-row { 
    display: flex; 
    flex-direction: row; 
    gap: 0.7rem; 
}
.company-field {
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;

    &.no-margin-bottom {
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }
}
.company-field__value {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    color: #25224a;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
}
.company-field__value--truncated {
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 4;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* ── Highlight cards ── */
.highlight-cards {
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    padding: 0.4rem;
}
.highlight-card {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.16rem;
    align-items: flex-start;
    margin-bottom: 0.28rem;
    &:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
}
.highlight-card__text { flex: 1; }
.highlight-card__title {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #25224a;
    margin-bottom: 0.04rem;
}
.highlight-card__desc {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: #464154;
}

/* ── Right sidebar ── */
.private-info-block {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    padding: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.sidebar-section { 
    margin-bottom: 0.32rem;
    &:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
}
.sidebar-section__title { font-size: 0.18rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; }
.sidebar-section__blur {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 0 -0.2rem;
}
.sidebar-section__blur img {
    width: 100%;
    display: block;
}
.sidebar-section__lock {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 2;
    color: #3e50f7;
    font-size: 0.24rem;
}
.sidebar-section__lock svg { width: 0.3rem; height: 0.3rem; }

/* ── Bottom banner ── */
.bottom-banner {
    background: radial-gradient(155.37% 120.73% at 94.83% 5.59%, #2f2b6d 55.35%, #1e1b3b);
    border-radius: 0.2rem;
    padding: 0.7rem 2.78rem;
    text-align: center;
    color: #fff;
    margin-top: 0.24rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
}
.bottom-banner__title { font-size: 0.32rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 0.1rem; line-height: 120%; }
.bottom-banner__desc { font-size: 0.14rem; font-weight: 400; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 0.24rem; }
.bottom-banner__features {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0;
    margin-top: 0.32rem;
    background: #3c377f;
    border: 1px solid #4b45a0;
    border-radius: 0.1rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    width: 100%;
}
.bottom-banner__feature {
    flex: 1;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 0.24rem 0.2rem;
}
.bottom-banner__feature-icon { display: flex; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; justify-content: center; }
.bottom-banner__feature-title {
    font-size: 0.1rem;
    line-height: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #9995C1;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    margin-bottom: 0.06rem;
}
.bottom-banner__feature-text { font-size: 0.12rem; color: #fff; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 700; }
.bottom-banner__feature-divider { display: none; }

/* ── Footer ── */
.footer {
    margin-top: auto;
}
.footer-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding-top: 0.32rem;
    padding-bottom: 0.27rem;
    border-top: 1px dotted rgba(42, 31, 65, 0.2);
    max-width: 15.6rem;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding-left: 0.72rem;
    padding-right: 0.72rem;
}
.footer-copy {
    font-size: 0.12rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: #6b7280;
}
.footer-contact {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding-right: 0.4rem;
}
.footer-contact .footer-link {
    color: #3e50f7;
    text-decoration: none;
}
.footer-contact .footer-link:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
}
.footer .mb-16 {
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}

/* ── Mini modal ── */
.mini-modal-trigger {
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-decoration-style: dotted;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
    text-decoration-color: #9ca3af;
}
.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; }
.mini-modal {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.2rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 4px 6px 14px 0 rgba(42, 31, 65, 0.16);
    z-index: 100;
    width: 3.2rem;
    max-width: 3.2rem;
}
.mini-modal--open { display: block; }
.mini-modal__title {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #25224a;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
    white-space: normal;
    text-transform: none;
}
.mini-modal__text {
    font-weight: 400;
    font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-transform: none;
    white-space: break-spaces;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0.1rem;
    right: 0.1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0.04rem;
    line-height: 1;
    font-size: 0.16rem;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close:hover { color: #25224a; }
.mini-modal__link {
    display: inline;
    color: #3e50f7;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: 500;
}
.mini-modal__link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.mini-modal-bg {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    z-index: 99;
}
.mini-modal-bg--open { display: block; }
/* Hero labels — white text needs white dotted underline */
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger { text-decoration-color: rgba(164, 161, 203, 0.5); }
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger:hover,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: #a4a1cb; }
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger .mini-modal,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger .mini-modal { white-space: normal; }

/* ── Shake animation ── */
.shaker {
    animation: shake 1s cubic-bezier(0.36, 0.07, 0.19, 0.97) both;
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    backface-visibility: hidden;
    perspective: 1000px;
}
@keyframes shake {
    10%, 90% { transform: translate3d(-1px, 0, 0); }
    20%, 80% { transform: translate3d(2px, 0, 0); }
    30%, 50%, 70% { transform: translate3d(-4px, 0, 0); }
    40%, 60% { transform: translate3d(4px, 0, 0); }
}
.section__blur, .sidebar-section__blur { cursor: pointer; }

                    <h1 class="listing-headline">Platform that offers B2B and B2C commerce and fundraising solutions, including IP and patents</h1>
                    <div class="expandable-text with-margin-bottom">
        <div class="listing-desc listing-desc--truncated" id="desc-main">As a technology and solutions company, our goal is to fundamentally change how needs (and wants) get exchanged through a marketplace that meshes eCommerce and fundraising into a patented and highly scalable method. From digital drives to online registries, the platform is built to revolutionize the way we tangible needs globally and effectively better the business of giving.

As a 'walled garden', the model captures revenue from both the sale of products and traditional percentage points on transactions.   

What We Solve: 

The business provides a central destination where tangible needs get met online. In our current landscape, there is a lack of a central destination for people to see the needs around them and fund them in a trusted, transparent, and highly efficient manner.   

Needs are currently dispersed across multiple non-profit websites, representing an antiquated method of achieving results. The business delivers this capability through meshing consumer shopping, with product fundraising to deliver the most tangible fundraising experience for both individuals and civic/NFP organizations. Effectively bringing all constituents together through a collective impact marketplace.

The patent is also open with continuance.  This provides the acquirer a clear path to carving out more of the innovation, further market capture and long-term monetization.</div>

                    <div class="listing-label listing-label__double-margin">Asking Price Reasoning</div>
                    <div class="expandable-text ">
        <div class="listing-desc listing-desc--truncated" id="desc-reasoning">In 2019 a 3rd party valuation was performed by a notable firm after the patent was awarded. The valuation was set at $100MM based on the early launch revenue of $1.75MM, patent being awarded and opening the platform to consumers (B2C) and nonprofits (B2B).

The valuation was deemed to be conservative when looking at the value of the venture on a global scale, with the device, method and stack to be replicable across countries, along with the licensing opportunity of the patent and technology to be repackaged and distributed in a white label capacity.

The offering has been assigned to open to offers based on acknowledging that the valuation does not determine the selling price. The founder sees this offering as a strategic opportunity for a buyer to carve out a large and growing market (within online giving, ESG, supply chain and eCommerce) which opens doors to working and partnering with premier brands and 3rd party resellers.</div>

        <div class="expandable-text ">
        <div class="company-field__value listing-desc--truncated" id="co-business-model">Customer Engagement
As a B2B and B2C marketplace the platform delivers a win-win scenario for participants.

Nonprofits, Civics Orgs and NGOs (B2B):
The business offers a powerful fundraising tool and marketplace that is fully impact-driven. Raise money for goods and services for projects and programs. We serve the nonprofit and civic sector in ways that create exponential impact and cost savings around tangible goods.

Consumers (B2C):
Everyday citizens shop and fundraise on the business making it open to all. As a central destination to give, gift, fundraise and shop, the platform extends itself to be used in the same capacity for their own needs and fundraising projects. 

Brands/Suppliers:
The business provides an effective sales channel to serve communities at scale - enabling companies and 3rd party resellers to do well by doing good in a 24x7 capacity through unique sales promotions for the nonprofit and civic sector.

Revenue Model:
It generates revenue from the sale of products to the B2C and B2B market, combined with fundraising fees associated from fundraising. Users create “need campaigns” in which funds accrue inside in a digital ledger (store credit) for purchasing merchandise from the marketplace.  
The model provides captured revenue from both fundraising transactions (%) and margin on the sale of goods. Further, the technology and patent extend monetization opportunities for the solution to be white-labeled or licensed for 3rd party implementations.</div>

var activeMiniModal = null;

function openMiniModal(trigger) {

    if (window.innerWidth > 1024) {
        var rect = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
        modal.style.top = (rect.bottom + 8) + 'px';
        modal.style.left = rect.left + 'px';
    } else {

        miniModalBg.className = 'mini-modal-bg';
        miniModalBg.addEventListener('click', function () { closeMiniModal(); });
        document.body.appendChild(miniModalBg);
    }

}
function closeMiniModal(e) {

function scrollToCtaAndShake() {

    var rect = cta.getBoundingClientRect();
    var scrollTop = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop;

    setTimeout(function () {
        cta.classList.add('shaker');
        setTimeout(function () { cta.classList.remove('shaker'); }, 1000);
    }, 400);
}

.perf-value { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.06rem; font-size: 0.14rem; line-height: 0.25rem; font-weight: 500; color: #25224a; }
.perf-value svg { width: 0.24rem; height: 0.24rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.perf-value__mobile { display: none; }

/* ── Expandable text wrapper ── */
.expandable-text {
    margin-top: 0.16rem;

    &.with-margin-bottom {
        margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    }
}
.expandable-text .listing-desc,
.expandable-text .company-field__value {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
.company-field .expandable-text {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* ── Truncated description with See more ── */
.listing-desc--truncated {
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    white-space: normal;
}
.see-more-link {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.04rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #1b1625;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin-top: 0.08rem;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 0.02rem;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0;
    font-family: inherit;
}
.see-more-link svg {
    transition: transform 0.2s ease;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}
.see-more-link.expanded svg {
    transform: rotate(180deg);
}

/* ── Price reduced badge ── */
.price-reduced-badge {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.06rem;
    padding: 0.06rem 0.12rem;
    border-radius: 0.04rem;
    border: 1px solid #3E50F7;
    background: #EEF2FE;           
    font-size: 0.1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #3E50F7;
    white-space: nowrap;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

/* ── Category icon card container ── */
.type-card__icon {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-width: 0.44rem;
    width: 0.44rem;
    height: 0.44rem;
    border-radius: 0.1rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    background: #fff;
}
.type-card__icon svg {
    width: 0.24rem;
    height: 0.24rem;
}

/* ── Annual snapshot table ── */
.annual-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
.annual-table th { font-size: 0.11rem; font-weight: 600; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: left; padding: 0.12rem 0.16rem; border-bottom: 0.02rem solid #f0f0f5; }
.annual-table td { font-size: 0.14rem; padding: 0.14rem 0.16rem; border-bottom: 0.01rem solid #f0f0f5; color: #25224a; }
.annual-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }

/* ── Blurred section (chart placeholder with lock) ── */
.blurred-section {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f0eef7, #e8e6f0);
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}
.blurred-section--chart {
    min-height: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.blurred-section--sidebar {
    min-height: 0.08rem;
}
.blurred-section::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(
        0deg,
        transparent,
        transparent 0.3rem,
        rgba(62, 80, 247, 0.03) 0.3rem,
        rgba(62, 80, 247, 0.03) 0.31rem
    );
    pointer-events: none;
}
.blurred-section svg {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* ── Metrics top row (customer metrics visible values) ── */
.metrics-top-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 0.2rem 0.3rem;
}
.metrics-top-item {
    position: relative;
    margin: 0 0 0.2rem;
    border-right: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
}
.metrics-top-item .listing-label {
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n),
.metrics-top-item:last-child {
    border-right: none;
}
/* Last row: no bottom margin (margin only separates rows). */
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):nth-last-child(-n + 4),
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):nth-last-child(-n + 4) ~ .metrics-top-item {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
/* Spacing below the grid only when the locked-chart blur follows it. */
.metrics-top-row + .section__blur {
    margin-top: 0.2rem;
}
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):not(:first-child)::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: -0.2rem;
    left: 0;
    width: calc(4 * 100% + 3 * 0.3rem);
    border-top: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
}
.metrics-top-value {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.08rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    color: #25224a;
}
.metrics-top-value svg { width: 0.24rem; height: 0.24rem; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* ── Bullet list ── */
.bullet-list {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.08rem;
}
.bullet-list li {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.1rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    color: #25224a;
    line-height: 1.5;
}
.bullet-list li::before {
    content: "";
    display: inline-block;
    width: 0.06rem;
    height: 0.06rem;
    min-width: 0.06rem;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #3e50f7;
    margin-top: 0.07rem;
}

/* ── Company field ── */
.companiey-fields-row { 
    display: flex; 
    flex-direction: row; 
    gap: 0.7rem; 
}
.company-field {
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;

    &.no-margin-bottom {
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }
}
.company-field__value {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    color: #25224a;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
}
.company-field__value--truncated {
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 4;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* ── Highlight cards ── */
.highlight-cards {
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    padding: 0.4rem;
}
.highlight-card {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.16rem;
    align-items: flex-start;
    margin-bottom: 0.28rem;
    &:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
}
.highlight-card__text { flex: 1; }
.highlight-card__title {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #25224a;
    margin-bottom: 0.04rem;
}
.highlight-card__desc {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: #464154;
}

/* ── Right sidebar ── */
.private-info-block {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    padding: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.sidebar-section { 
    margin-bottom: 0.32rem;
    &:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
}
.sidebar-section__title { font-size: 0.18rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; }
.sidebar-section__blur {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 0 -0.2rem;
}
.sidebar-section__blur img {
    width: 100%;
    display: block;
}
.sidebar-section__lock {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 2;
    color: #3e50f7;
    font-size: 0.24rem;
}
.sidebar-section__lock svg { width: 0.3rem; height: 0.3rem; }

/* ── Bottom banner ── */
.bottom-banner {
    background: radial-gradient(155.37% 120.73% at 94.83% 5.59%, #2f2b6d 55.35%, #1e1b3b);
    border-radius: 0.2rem;
    padding: 0.7rem 2.78rem;
    text-align: center;
    color: #fff;
    margin-top: 0.24rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
}
.bottom-banner__title { font-size: 0.32rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 0.1rem; line-height: 120%; }
.bottom-banner__desc { font-size: 0.14rem; font-weight: 400; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 0.24rem; }
.bottom-banner__features {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0;
    margin-top: 0.32rem;
    background: #3c377f;
    border: 1px solid #4b45a0;
    border-radius: 0.1rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    width: 100%;
}
.bottom-banner__feature {
    flex: 1;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 0.24rem 0.2rem;
}
.bottom-banner__feature-icon { display: flex; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; justify-content: center; }
.bottom-banner__feature-title {
    font-size: 0.1rem;
    line-height: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #9995C1;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    margin-bottom: 0.06rem;
}
.bottom-banner__feature-text { font-size: 0.12rem; color: #fff; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 700; }
.bottom-banner__feature-divider { display: none; }

/* ── Footer ── */
.footer {
    margin-top: auto;
}
.footer-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding-top: 0.32rem;
    padding-bottom: 0.27rem;
    border-top: 1px dotted rgba(42, 31, 65, 0.2);
    max-width: 15.6rem;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding-left: 0.72rem;
    padding-right: 0.72rem;
}
.footer-copy {
    font-size: 0.12rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: #6b7280;
}
.footer-contact {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding-right: 0.4rem;
}
.footer-contact .footer-link {
    color: #3e50f7;
    text-decoration: none;
}
.footer-contact .footer-link:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
}
.footer .mb-16 {
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}

/* ── Mini modal ── */
.mini-modal-trigger {
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-decoration-style: dotted;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
    text-decoration-color: #9ca3af;
}
.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; }
.mini-modal {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.2rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 4px 6px 14px 0 rgba(42, 31, 65, 0.16);
    z-index: 100;
    width: 3.2rem;
    max-width: 3.2rem;
}
.mini-modal--open { display: block; }
.mini-modal__title {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #25224a;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
    white-space: normal;
    text-transform: none;
}
.mini-modal__text {
    font-weight: 400;
    font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-transform: none;
    white-space: break-spaces;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0.1rem;
    right: 0.1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0.04rem;
    line-height: 1;
    font-size: 0.16rem;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close:hover { color: #25224a; }
.mini-modal__link {
    display: inline;
    color: #3e50f7;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: 500;
}
.mini-modal__link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.mini-modal-bg {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    z-index: 99;
}
.mini-modal-bg--open { display: block; }
/* Hero labels — white text needs white dotted underline */
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger { text-decoration-color: rgba(164, 161, 203, 0.5); }
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger:hover,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: #a4a1cb; }
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger .mini-modal,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger .mini-modal { white-space: normal; }

/* ── Shake animation ── */
.shaker {
    animation: shake 1s cubic-bezier(0.36, 0.07, 0.19, 0.97) both;
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    backface-visibility: hidden;
    perspective: 1000px;
}
@keyframes shake {
    10%, 90% { transform: translate3d(-1px, 0, 0); }
    20%, 80% { transform: translate3d(2px, 0, 0); }
    30%, 50%, 70% { transform: translate3d(-4px, 0, 0); }
    40%, 60% { transform: translate3d(4px, 0, 0); }
}
.section__blur, .sidebar-section__blur { cursor: pointer; }

/* ── Mobile CTA bar ── */
.mobile-cta-bar { display: none; }

    transition: box-shadow 0.3s ease-out;
    gap: 0.11rem;
}
.nav-menu-btn:hover { box-shadow: 0.04rem 0.06rem 0.08rem 0 rgba(42,31,65,0.56); }
.nav-menu-btn svg:first-child { width: 0.12rem; height: 0.07rem; }
.nav-menu-btn svg:last-child { width: 0.23rem; height: 0.23rem; }
.nav-menu-dropdown {
    display: none;
    position: absolute;
    top: calc(100% + 0.08rem);
    right: 0;
    width: 2rem;
    border-radius: 0 0.1rem 0.1rem 0.1rem;
    box-shadow: 0.04rem 0.06rem 0.08rem 0 rgba(42,31,65,0.56);
    background: #fff;
    z-index: 200;
    overflow: hidden;
}
.nav-menu-dropdown--open { display: block; }
.nav-menu-dropdown__section {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: 0.1rem 0 0.12rem;
}
.nav-menu-dropdown__section:first-child { border-bottom: 1px solid #a8a7b7; }
.nav-menu-dropdown__item {
    display: block;
    padding: 0.08rem 0.23rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    color: #6b7280;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: background 0.3s;
}
.nav-menu-dropdown__item--primary { color: #25224a; font-weight: 500; }
.nav-menu-dropdown__item:hover { background: #f5f4f8; }

/* ── Container ── */
.container { max-width: 15.6rem; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0.24rem 0.72rem 0.72rem; }

/* ── Hero ── */
.hero {
    background: linear-gradient(45deg, #1e1b3b 40%, #2f2b6d 60%);
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    padding: 0.4rem;
    color: #fff;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}
.hero__top { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; }
.hero__category { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.08rem; }
.hero__category-text { font-size: 0.12rem; color: #a4a1cb; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.3px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.04rem; }
.hero__category-text svg { width: 0.18rem; height: 0.18rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.hero__category-text a { color: #a4a1cb; text-decoration: underline; }
.hero__location { font-size: 0.12rem; line-height: 0.18rem; color: #a4a1cb; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.3px; margin-left: 0.16rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.04rem; }
.hero__location svg { width: 0.18rem; height: 0.18rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.hero__name-blocker {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.1rem;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #3c377f 10%, #6b63e5 70%, #3c377f 100%);
    border: 1px solid #4b45a0;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    padding: 0.12rem 0.52rem;
    margin: 0.16rem auto;
}
.hero__name-blocker svg { width: 0.16rem; height: 0.16rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.hero__name-blocker span { font-size: 0.14rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 0.24rem; color: #fff; }
.hero__headline {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.24rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: #a4a1cb;
    text-align: center;
    max-width: 5.72rem;
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
}
.hero__badges { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 0.04rem; margin-top: 0.16rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.badge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.04rem;
    background: #27245b;
    border: 1px solid #4b45a0;
    padding: .08rem .12rem;
    border-radius: .9rem;       
    font-size: 0.12rem;
    line-height: 0.18rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #fff;
}
.badge svg { width: 0.16rem; height: 0.16rem; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* ── Hero bottom: metrics + CTA ── */
.hero__bottom { display: flex; gap: 0.4rem; margin-top: 0.32rem; }

/* ── Metrics column ── */
.metrics-col { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.metrics-card {
    background: #3c377f;
    border-radius: 0.1rem;
    border: 1px solid #4b45a0;
    padding: 0.3rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.1rem;
}
.metrics-card:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.metrics-card__row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; }
.metrics-card__divider { width: 1px; align-self: stretch; background: #4b45a0; margin: 0 0.2rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.metrics-card__label { font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 700; color: #a4a1cb; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-bottom: 0.08rem; white-space: nowrap; }
.metrics-card__value { font-size: 0.18rem; line-height: 0.24rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; white-space: nowrap; }

/* Revenue bars */
.rev-row { margin-bottom: 0.38rem; }
.rev-row:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.rev-header { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; margin-bottom: 0.12rem; }
.rev-header__col { width: 1.4rem; margin-right: 0.25rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.rev-header__label { font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; color: #a4a1cb; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-bottom: 0.06rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.06rem; }
.rev-header__label::before { content: ""; display: inline-block; width: 0.08rem; height: 0.08rem; border-radius: 0.02rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.rev-header__label--revenue::before { background: #5650AC; }
.rev-header__label--profit-ttm::before { background: #7EDC72; }
.rev-header__label--profit-lm::before { background: #72BCDC; }
.rev-header__value { font-size: 0.2rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; line-height: 1.2; white-space: nowrap; }
.rev-bar {
    height: 0.1rem;
    border-radius: 0.22rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    background:
        repeating-linear-gradient(
            135deg,
            #5650AC 0 .28rem,
            #4B4696 0 .33rem
        ) 0 / 100%;
}
.rev-bar__fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 0.22rem; }

/* ── CTA column (hero) ── */
.cta-col { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.cta-card {
    border: 1px dashed #6b66b6;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    background: linear-gradient(45deg, #2F2B6D 60%, #1E1B3B 100%);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;
    height: 100%;
    padding: 0 1.06rem;
    width: 5.88rem;
    height: 3.42rem;
}
.cta-card__icon { display: flex; height: 0.3rem; margin-bottom: 0.26rem; }
.cta-card__title { font-size: 0.18rem; line-height: 0.24rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 11px; }
.cta-card__desc { font-size: 0.16rem; color: #a4a1cb; margin-bottom: 0.28rem; line-height: 0.24rem; }
.cta-card__btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    width: 2.54rem;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.08rem;
    padding: 0.16rem 0.26rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 0 0.09rem 0.09rem;
    font-size: 0.13rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #000;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: opacity 0.2s;
}
.cta-card__btn:hover { opacity: 0.85; text-decoration: none; }

/* ── Content area ── */
.content { display: flex; gap: 0.16rem; }
.content__left { 
    padding: 0.1rem; 
    flex: 5; 
    min-width: 0; 
    background: #fff; 
    border-radius: 0.09rem; 
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    max-width: 8rem;
}
.content__right { width: 4.76rem; }

/* ── Sections ── */
.section {
    padding: 0 0.3rem 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
.section__header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.09rem;
    padding: 0.2rem 0;
    margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
    border-bottom: 0.02rem solid #f0f0f5;
    background: #f5f7ff;
    border-radius: 0.06rem;
    padding: 0.3rem;
    margin: 0 -0.3rem 0.4rem;
    border-bottom: none;
}
.section__title { font-size: 0.16rem; line-height: 0.21rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; }
.section__updated { font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 500; color: #7f798d; margin-left: auto; }
.section__provider-logo { height: 0.26rem; width: auto; margin-left: 0.06rem; }
.section__category-badge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.06rem;
    font-size: 0.16rem;
    font-weight: 700;
}
.section__location { font-size: 0.14rem; color: #7f798d; margin-left: 0.12rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.04rem; }
.section__location svg { width: 0.14rem; height: 0.14rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.section__location svg path { fill: #7f798d; }
.section__blur {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 0 -0.32rem;
}
.section__blur img {
    width: 100%;
    display: block;
}

.listing-headline { font-size: 0.16rem; font-weight: 500; color: #25224a; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; line-height: 1.4; }
.listing-desc { font-size: 0.14rem; color: #464154; line-height: 0.22rem; white-space: pre-line; margin-bottom: 0.24rem; }
.listing-label { font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 700; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-bottom: 0.08rem; }
.listing-label__double-margin { margin-bottom: 0.16rem; }
.listing-value { font-size: 0.18rem; line-height: 0.24rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; }
.listing-value__underlined { border-bottom: 1px dotted #7F798D; }

.price-row { display: flex; gap: 0.7rem; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }

/* ── Performance ── */
.perf-grid { display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 0.7rem; }
.perf-item { text-align: left; }
.perf-label { width: fit-content; display: block; font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 600; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-bottom: 0.08rem; }
.perf-value { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.06rem; font-size: 0.14rem; line-height: 0.25rem; font-weight: 500; color: #25224a; }
.perf-value svg { width: 0.24rem; height: 0.24rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.perf-value__mobile { display: none; }

/* ── Expandable text wrapper ── */
.expandable-text {
    margin-top: 0.16rem;

    &.with-margin-bottom {
        margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    }
}
.expandable-text .listing-desc,
.expandable-text .company-field__value {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
.company-field .expandable-text {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* ── Truncated description with See more ── */
.listing-desc--truncated {
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    white-space: normal;
}
.see-more-link {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.04rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #1b1625;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin-top: 0.08rem;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 0.02rem;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0;
    font-family: inherit;
}
.see-more-link svg {
    transition: transform 0.2s ease;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}
.see-more-link.expanded svg {
    transform: rotate(180deg);
}

/* ── Price reduced badge ── */
.price-reduced-badge {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.06rem;
    padding: 0.06rem 0.12rem;
    border-radius: 0.04rem;
    border: 1px solid #3E50F7;
    background: #EEF2FE;           
    font-size: 0.1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #3E50F7;
    white-space: nowrap;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

/* ── Category icon card container ── */
.type-card__icon {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-width: 0.44rem;
    width: 0.44rem;
    height: 0.44rem;
    border-radius: 0.1rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    background: #fff;
}
.type-card__icon svg {
    width: 0.24rem;
    height: 0.24rem;
}

/* ── Annual snapshot table ── */
.annual-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
.annual-table th { font-size: 0.11rem; font-weight: 600; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: left; padding: 0.12rem 0.16rem; border-bottom: 0.02rem solid #f0f0f5; }
.annual-table td { font-size: 0.14rem; padding: 0.14rem 0.16rem; border-bottom: 0.01rem solid #f0f0f5; color: #25224a; }
.annual-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }

/* ── Blurred section (chart placeholder with lock) ── */
.blurred-section {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f0eef7, #e8e6f0);
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}
.blurred-section--chart {
    min-height: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.blurred-section--sidebar {
    min-height: 0.08rem;
}
.blurred-section::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(
        0deg,
        transparent,
        transparent 0.3rem,
        rgba(62, 80, 247, 0.03) 0.3rem,
        rgba(62, 80, 247, 0.03) 0.31rem
    );
    pointer-events: none;
}
.blurred-section svg {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* ── Metrics top row (customer metrics visible values) ── */
.metrics-top-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 0.2rem 0.3rem;
}
.metrics-top-item {
    position: relative;
    margin: 0 0 0.2rem;
    border-right: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
}
.metrics-top-item .listing-label {
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n),
.metrics-top-item:last-child {
    border-right: none;
}
/* Last row: no bottom margin (margin only separates rows). */
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):nth-last-child(-n + 4),
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):nth-last-child(-n + 4) ~ .metrics-top-item {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
/* Spacing below the grid only when the locked-chart blur follows it. */
.metrics-top-row + .section__blur {
    margin-top: 0.2rem;
}
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):not(:first-child)::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: -0.2rem;
    left: 0;
    width: calc(4 * 100% + 3 * 0.3rem);
    border-top: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
}
.metrics-top-value {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.08rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    color: #25224a;
}
.metrics-top-value svg { width: 0.24rem; height: 0.24rem; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* ── Bullet list ── */
.bullet-list {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.08rem;
}
.bullet-list li {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.1rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    color: #25224a;
    line-height: 1.5;
}
.bullet-list li::before {
    content: "";
    display: inline-block;
    width: 0.06rem;
    height: 0.06rem;
    min-width: 0.06rem;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #3e50f7;
    margin-top: 0.07rem;
}

/* ── Company field ── */
.companiey-fields-row { 
    display: flex; 
    flex-direction: row; 
    gap: 0.7rem; 
}
.company-field {
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;

    &.no-margin-bottom {
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }
}
.company-field__value {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    color: #25224a;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
}
.company-field__value--truncated {
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 4;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* ── Highlight cards ── */
.highlight-cards {
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    padding: 0.4rem;
}
.highlight-card {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.16rem;
    align-items: flex-start;
    margin-bottom: 0.28rem;
    &:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
}
.highlight-card__text { flex: 1; }
.highlight-card__title {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #25224a;
    margin-bottom: 0.04rem;
}
.highlight-card__desc {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: #464154;
}

/* ── Right sidebar ── */
.private-info-block {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    padding: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.sidebar-section { 
    margin-bottom: 0.32rem;
    &:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
}
.sidebar-section__title { font-size: 0.18rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; }
.sidebar-section__blur {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 0 -0.2rem;
}
.sidebar-section__blur img {
    width: 100%;
    display: block;
}
.sidebar-section__lock {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 2;
    color: #3e50f7;
    font-size: 0.24rem;
}
.sidebar-section__lock svg { width: 0.3rem; height: 0.3rem; }

/* ── Bottom banner ── */
.bottom-banner {
    background: radial-gradient(155.37% 120.73% at 94.83% 5.59%, #2f2b6d 55.35%, #1e1b3b);
    border-radius: 0.2rem;
    padding: 0.7rem 2.78rem;
    text-align: center;
    color: #fff;
    margin-top: 0.24rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
}
.bottom-banner__title { font-size: 0.32rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 0.1rem; line-height: 120%; }
.bottom-banner__desc { font-size: 0.14rem; font-weight: 400; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 0.24rem; }
.bottom-banner__features {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0;
    margin-top: 0.32rem;
    background: #3c377f;
    border: 1px solid #4b45a0;
    border-radius: 0.1rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    width: 100%;
}
.bottom-banner__feature {
    flex: 1;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 0.24rem 0.2rem;
}
.bottom-banner__feature-icon { display: flex; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; justify-content: center; }
.bottom-banner__feature-title {
    font-size: 0.1rem;
    line-height: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #9995C1;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    margin-bottom: 0.06rem;
}
.bottom-banner__feature-text { font-size: 0.12rem; color: #fff; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 700; }
.bottom-banner__feature-divider { display: none; }

/* ── Footer ── */
.footer {
    margin-top: auto;
}
.footer-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding-top: 0.32rem;
    padding-bottom: 0.27rem;
    border-top: 1px dotted rgba(42, 31, 65, 0.2);
    max-width: 15.6rem;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding-left: 0.72rem;
    padding-right: 0.72rem;
}
.footer-copy {
    font-size: 0.12rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: #6b7280;
}
.footer-contact {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding-right: 0.4rem;
}
.footer-contact .footer-link {
    color: #3e50f7;
    text-decoration: none;
}
.footer-contact .footer-link:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
}
.footer .mb-16 {
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}

/* ── Mini modal ── */
.mini-modal-trigger {
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-decoration-style: dotted;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
    text-decoration-color: #9ca3af;
}
.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; }
.mini-modal {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.2rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 4px 6px 14px 0 rgba(42, 31, 65, 0.16);
    z-index: 100;
    width: 3.2rem;
    max-width: 3.2rem;
}
.mini-modal--open { display: block; }
.mini-modal__title {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #25224a;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
    white-space: normal;
    text-transform: none;
}
.mini-modal__text {
    font-weight: 400;
    font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-transform: none;
    white-space: break-spaces;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0.1rem;
    right: 0.1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0.04rem;
    line-height: 1;
    font-size: 0.16rem;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close:hover { color: #25224a; }
.mini-modal__link {

/* ── Shake animation ── */
.shaker {
    animation: shake 1s cubic-bezier(0.36, 0.07, 0.19, 0.97) both;
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    backface-visibility: hidden;
    perspective: 1000px;
}
@keyframes shake {
    10%, 90% { transform: translate3d(-1px, 0, 0); }
    20%, 80% { transform: translate3d(2px, 0, 0); }
    30%, 50%, 70% { transform: translate3d(-4px, 0, 0); }
    40%, 60% { transform: translate3d(4px, 0, 0); }

                    <h1 class="listing-headline">Profitable political simulation game for iOS and Android with reusable Unity engine</h1>
                    <div class="expandable-text with-margin-bottom">
        <div class="listing-desc listing-desc--truncated" id="desc-main">A profitable political and life simulation game built in Unity and available on iOS and Android. Since launching in July 2025, the game has generated more than $1.1M in net revenue and approximately $385K in net profit through a diversified monetization model that includes in-app purchases, recurring subscriptions, and advertising. The acquisition includes the complete Unity source code, featuring a reusable simulation engine that can be adapted into new themes such as business, romance, or celebrity simulations, providing a foundation for future game development and expansion.

Key Highlights
✅ Profitable political and life simulation game for iOS and Android
✅ Generated over $1.1M in net revenue and approximately $385K in net profit since launch
✅ Monetized through in-app purchases, recurring subscriptions, and AdMob advertising
✅ Includes 3,800+ active subscribers and a proven paid user acquisition system
✅ Fully client-side architecture with minimal operating costs and no dedicated server infrastructure
✅ Acquisition includes the complete Unity source code and a reusable simulation engine for future game development</div>

    <script>
function toggleNavMenu() {
    var dd = document.getElementById('nav-menu-dropdown');
    dd.classList.toggle('nav-menu-dropdown--open');
}
document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var wrapper = document.querySelector('.nav-menu-wrapper');
    var dd = document.getElementById('nav-menu-dropdown');
    if (wrapper && dd && !wrapper.contains(e.target)) {
        dd.classList.remove('nav-menu-dropdown--open');
    }
});
function toggleDesc(id, btn) {
    var desc = document.getElementById(id);
    var expanded = btn.classList.contains('expanded');
    var textNode = btn.firstChild;
    if (expanded) {
        desc.classList.add('listing-desc--truncated');
        btn.classList.remove('expanded');
        textNode.textContent = 'See more ';
    } else {
        desc.classList.remove('listing-desc--truncated');
        btn.classList.add('expanded');
        textNode.textContent = 'See less ';
    }
}
var activeMiniModal = null;
var miniModalBg = null;
function openMiniModal(trigger) {
    closeMiniModal();
    var modal = trigger.querySelector('.mini-modal');
    if (!modal) return;
    if (window.innerWidth > 1024) {
        var rect = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
        modal.style.top = (rect.bottom + 8) + 'px';
        modal.style.left = rect.left + 'px';
    } else {
        modal.style.top = '';
        modal.style.left = '';
    }
    modal.classList.add('mini-modal--open');
    activeMiniModal = modal;
    if (!miniModalBg) {
        miniModalBg = document.createElement('div');
        miniModalBg.className = 'mini-modal-bg';
        miniModalBg.addEventListener('click', function () { closeMiniModal(); });
        document.body.appendChild(miniModalBg);
    }
    miniModalBg.classList.add('mini-modal-bg--open');
}
function closeMiniModal(e) {
    if (e) { e.stopPropagation(); }
    if (activeMiniModal) {
        activeMiniModal.classList.remove('mini-modal--open');
        activeMiniModal = null;
    }

    flex-direction: row; 
    gap: 0.7rem; 
}
.company-field {
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;

    &.no-margin-bottom {
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }
}
.company-field__value {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    color: #25224a;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
}
.company-field__value--truncated {
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 4;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* ── Highlight cards ── */
.highlight-cards {
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    padding: 0.4rem;
}
.highlight-card {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.16rem;
    align-items: flex-start;
    margin-bottom: 0.28rem;
    &:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
}
.highlight-card__text { flex: 1; }
.highlight-card__title {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #25224a;
    margin-bottom: 0.04rem;
}
.highlight-card__desc {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: #464154;
}

/* ── Right sidebar ── */
.private-info-block {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    padding: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.sidebar-section { 
    margin-bottom: 0.32rem;
    &:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
}
.sidebar-section__title { font-size: 0.18rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; }
.sidebar-section__blur {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 0 -0.2rem;
}
.sidebar-section__blur img {
    width: 100%;
    display: block;
}
.sidebar-section__lock {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 2;
    color: #3e50f7;
    font-size: 0.24rem;
}
.sidebar-section__lock svg { width: 0.3rem; height: 0.3rem; }

/* ── Bottom banner ── */
.bottom-banner {
    background: radial-gradient(155.37% 120.73% at 94.83% 5.59%, #2f2b6d 55.35%, #1e1b3b);
    border-radius: 0.2rem;
    padding: 0.7rem 2.78rem;
    text-align: center;
    color: #fff;
    margin-top: 0.24rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
}
.bottom-banner__title { font-size: 0.32rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 0.1rem; line-height: 120%; }
.bottom-banner__desc { font-size: 0.14rem; font-weight: 400; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 0.24rem; }
.bottom-banner__features {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0;
    margin-top: 0.32rem;
    background: #3c377f;
    border: 1px solid #4b45a0;
    border-radius: 0.1rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    width: 100%;
}
.bottom-banner__feature {
    flex: 1;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 0.24rem 0.2rem;
}
.bottom-banner__feature-icon { display: flex; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; justify-content: center; }
.bottom-banner__feature-title {
    font-size: 0.1rem;
    line-height: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #9995C1;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    margin-bottom: 0.06rem;
}
.bottom-banner__feature-text { font-size: 0.12rem; color: #fff; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 700; }
.bottom-banner__feature-divider { display: none; }

/* ── Footer ── */
.footer {
    margin-top: auto;
}
.footer-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding-top: 0.32rem;
    padding-bottom: 0.27rem;
    border-top: 1px dotted rgba(42, 31, 65, 0.2);
    max-width: 15.6rem;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding-left: 0.72rem;
    padding-right: 0.72rem;
}
.footer-copy {
    font-size: 0.12rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: #6b7280;
}
.footer-contact {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding-right: 0.4rem;
}
.footer-contact .footer-link {
    color: #3e50f7;
    text-decoration: none;
}
.footer-contact .footer-link:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
}
.footer .mb-16 {
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}

/* ── Mini modal ── */
.mini-modal-trigger {
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-decoration-style: dotted;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
    text-decoration-color: #9ca3af;
}
.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; }
.mini-modal {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.2rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 4px 6px 14px 0 rgba(42, 31, 65, 0.16);
    z-index: 100;
    width: 3.2rem;
    max-width: 3.2rem;
}
.mini-modal--open { display: block; }
.mini-modal__title {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #25224a;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
    white-space: normal;
    text-transform: none;
}
.mini-modal__text {
    font-weight: 400;
    font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-transform: none;
    white-space: break-spaces;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0.1rem;
    right: 0.1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0.04rem;
    line-height: 1;
    font-size: 0.16rem;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close:hover { color: #25224a; }
.mini-modal__link {
    display: inline;
    color: #3e50f7;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: 500;
}
.mini-modal__link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.mini-modal-bg {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    z-index: 99;
}
.mini-modal-bg--open { display: block; }
/* Hero labels — white text needs white dotted underline */
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger { text-decoration-color: rgba(164, 161, 203, 0.5); }
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger:hover,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: #a4a1cb; }
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger .mini-modal,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger .mini-modal { white-space: normal; }

/* ── Shake animation ── */
.shaker {
    animation: shake 1s cubic-bezier(0.36, 0.07, 0.19, 0.97) both;
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    backface-visibility: hidden;
    perspective: 1000px;
}
@keyframes shake {
    10%, 90% { transform: translate3d(-1px, 0, 0); }
    20%, 80% { transform: translate3d(2px, 0, 0); }
    30%, 50%, 70% { transform: translate3d(-4px, 0, 0); }
    40%, 60% { transform: translate3d(4px, 0, 0); }
}
.section__blur, .sidebar-section__blur { cursor: pointer; }

/* ── Mobile CTA bar ── */
.mobile-cta-bar { display: none; }

var activeMiniModal = null;
var miniModalBg = null;
function openMiniModal(trigger) {
    closeMiniModal();
    var modal = trigger.querySelector('.mini-modal');
    if (!modal) return;
    if (window.innerWidth > 1024) {
        var rect = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
        modal.style.top = (rect.bottom + 8) + 'px';
        modal.style.left = rect.left + 'px';
    } else {
        modal.style.top = '';
        modal.style.left = '';
    }
    modal.classList.add('mini-modal--open');
    activeMiniModal = modal;
    if (!miniModalBg) {
        miniModalBg = document.createElement('div');
        miniModalBg.className = 'mini-modal-bg';
        miniModalBg.addEventListener('click', function () { closeMiniModal(); });
        document.body.appendChild(miniModalBg);
    }
    miniModalBg.classList.add('mini-modal-bg--open');
}
function closeMiniModal(e) {
    if (e) { e.stopPropagation(); }
    if (activeMiniModal) {
        activeMiniModal.classList.remove('mini-modal--open');
        activeMiniModal = null;
    }
    if (miniModalBg) { miniModalBg.classList.remove('mini-modal-bg--open'); }

function scrollToCtaAndShake() {
    var cta = document.querySelector('.cta-card');
    if (!cta) return;
    var rect = cta.getBoundingClientRect();
    var scrollTop = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
    window.scrollTo({ top: rect.top + scrollTop - 100, behavior: 'smooth' });
    setTimeout(function () {
        cta.classList.add('shaker');
        setTimeout(function () { cta.classList.remove('shaker'); }, 1000);
    }, 400);
}

                openMiniModal(trigger);
            }
        });
    });
});
