    max-width: 8rem;
}
.content__right { width: 4.76rem; }

/* ── Sections ── */
.section {
    padding: 0 0.3rem 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
.section__header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.09rem;
    padding: 0.2rem 0;
    margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
    border-bottom: 0.02rem solid #f0f0f5;
    background: #f5f7ff;
    border-radius: 0.06rem;
    padding: 0.3rem;
    margin: 0 -0.3rem 0.4rem;
    border-bottom: none;
}
.section__title { font-size: 0.16rem; line-height: 0.21rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; }
.section__updated { font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 500; color: #7f798d; margin-left: auto; }
.section__provider-logo { height: 0.26rem; width: auto; margin-left: 0.06rem; }
.section__category-badge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.06rem;
    font-size: 0.16rem;
    font-weight: 700;
}
.section__location { font-size: 0.14rem; color: #7f798d; margin-left: 0.12rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.04rem; }
.section__location svg { width: 0.14rem; height: 0.14rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.section__location svg path { fill: #7f798d; }
.section__blur {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 0 -0.32rem;
}
.section__blur img {
    width: 100%;
    display: block;
}

.listing-headline { font-size: 0.16rem; font-weight: 500; color: #25224a; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; line-height: 1.4; }
.listing-desc { font-size: 0.14rem; color: #464154; line-height: 0.22rem; white-space: pre-line; margin-bottom: 0.24rem; }
.listing-label { font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 700; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-bottom: 0.08rem; }
.listing-label__double-margin { margin-bottom: 0.16rem; }
.listing-value { font-size: 0.18rem; line-height: 0.24rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; }
.listing-value__underlined { border-bottom: 1px dotted #7F798D; }

.price-row { display: flex; gap: 0.7rem; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }

/* ── Performance ── */
.perf-grid { display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 0.7rem; }
.perf-item { text-align: left; }
.perf-label { width: fit-content; display: block; font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 600; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-bottom: 0.08rem; }
.perf-value { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.06rem; font-size: 0.14rem; line-height: 0.25rem; font-weight: 500; color: #25224a; }
.perf-value svg { width: 0.24rem; height: 0.24rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.perf-value__mobile { display: none; }

/* ── Expandable text wrapper ── */
.expandable-text {
    margin-top: 0.16rem;

    &.with-margin-bottom {
        margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    }
}
.expandable-text .listing-desc,
.expandable-text .company-field__value {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
.company-field .expandable-text {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* ── Truncated description with See more ── */
.listing-desc--truncated {
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    white-space: normal;
}
.see-more-link {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.04rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #1b1625;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin-top: 0.08rem;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 0.02rem;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0;
    font-family: inherit;
}
.see-more-link svg {
    transition: transform 0.2s ease;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}
.see-more-link.expanded svg {
    transform: rotate(180deg);
}

/* ── Price reduced badge ── */
.price-reduced-badge {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.06rem;
    padding: 0.06rem 0.12rem;
    border-radius: 0.04rem;
    border: 1px solid #3E50F7;
    background: #EEF2FE;           
    font-size: 0.1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #3E50F7;
    white-space: nowrap;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

/* ── Category icon card container ── */
.type-card__icon {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-width: 0.44rem;
    width: 0.44rem;
    height: 0.44rem;
    border-radius: 0.1rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    background: #fff;
}
.type-card__icon svg {
    width: 0.24rem;
    height: 0.24rem;
}

/* ── Annual snapshot table ── */
.annual-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
.annual-table th { font-size: 0.11rem; font-weight: 600; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: left; padding: 0.12rem 0.16rem; border-bottom: 0.02rem solid #f0f0f5; }
.annual-table td { font-size: 0.14rem; padding: 0.14rem 0.16rem; border-bottom: 0.01rem solid #f0f0f5; color: #25224a; }
.annual-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }

/* ── Blurred section (chart placeholder with lock) ── */
.blurred-section {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f0eef7, #e8e6f0);
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}
.blurred-section--chart {
    min-height: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.blurred-section--sidebar {
    min-height: 0.08rem;
}
.blurred-section::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(
        0deg,
        transparent,
        transparent 0.3rem,
        rgba(62, 80, 247, 0.03) 0.3rem,
        rgba(62, 80, 247, 0.03) 0.31rem
    );
    pointer-events: none;
}
.blurred-section svg {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* ── Metrics top row (customer metrics visible values) ── */
.metrics-top-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 0.2rem 0.3rem;
}
.metrics-top-item {
    position: relative;
    margin: 0 0 0.2rem;
    border-right: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
}
.metrics-top-item .listing-label {
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n),
.metrics-top-item:last-child {
    border-right: none;
}
/* Last row: no bottom margin (margin only separates rows). */
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):nth-last-child(-n + 4),
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):nth-last-child(-n + 4) ~ .metrics-top-item {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
/* Spacing below the grid only when the locked-chart blur follows it. */
.metrics-top-row + .section__blur {
    margin-top: 0.2rem;
}
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):not(:first-child)::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: -0.2rem;
    left: 0;
    width: calc(4 * 100% + 3 * 0.3rem);
    border-top: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
}
.metrics-top-value {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.08rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    color: #25224a;
}
.metrics-top-value svg { width: 0.24rem; height: 0.24rem; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* ── Bullet list ── */
.bullet-list {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.08rem;
}
.bullet-list li {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.1rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    color: #25224a;
    line-height: 1.5;
}
.bullet-list li::before {
    content: "";
    display: inline-block;
    width: 0.06rem;
    height: 0.06rem;
    min-width: 0.06rem;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #3e50f7;
    margin-top: 0.07rem;
}

/* ── Company field ── */
.companiey-fields-row { 
    display: flex; 
    flex-direction: row; 
    gap: 0.7rem; 
}
.company-field {
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;

    &.no-margin-bottom {
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }
}
.company-field__value {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    color: #25224a;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
}
.company-field__value--truncated {
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 4;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* ── Highlight cards ── */
.highlight-cards {
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    padding: 0.4rem;
}
.highlight-card {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.16rem;
    align-items: flex-start;
    margin-bottom: 0.28rem;
    &:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
}
.highlight-card__text { flex: 1; }
.highlight-card__title {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #25224a;
    margin-bottom: 0.04rem;
}
.highlight-card__desc {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: #464154;
}

/* ── Right sidebar ── */
.private-info-block {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    padding: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.sidebar-section { 
    margin-bottom: 0.32rem;
    &:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
}
.sidebar-section__title { font-size: 0.18rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; }
.sidebar-section__blur {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 0 -0.2rem;
}
.sidebar-section__blur img {
    width: 100%;
    display: block;
}
.sidebar-section__lock {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 2;
    color: #3e50f7;
    font-size: 0.24rem;
}
.sidebar-section__lock svg { width: 0.3rem; height: 0.3rem; }

/* ── Bottom banner ── */
.bottom-banner {
    background: radial-gradient(155.37% 120.73% at 94.83% 5.59%, #2f2b6d 55.35%, #1e1b3b);
    border-radius: 0.2rem;
    padding: 0.7rem 2.78rem;
    text-align: center;
    color: #fff;
    margin-top: 0.24rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
}
.bottom-banner__title { font-size: 0.32rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 0.1rem; line-height: 120%; }
.bottom-banner__desc { font-size: 0.14rem; font-weight: 400; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 0.24rem; }
.bottom-banner__features {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0;
    margin-top: 0.32rem;
    background: #3c377f;
    border: 1px solid #4b45a0;
    border-radius: 0.1rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    width: 100%;
}
.bottom-banner__feature {
    flex: 1;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 0.24rem 0.2rem;
}
.bottom-banner__feature-icon { display: flex; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; justify-content: center; }
.bottom-banner__feature-title {
    font-size: 0.1rem;
    line-height: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #9995C1;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    margin-bottom: 0.06rem;
}
.bottom-banner__feature-text { font-size: 0.12rem; color: #fff; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 700; }
.bottom-banner__feature-divider { display: none; }

/* ── Footer ── */
.footer {
    margin-top: auto;
}
.footer-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding-top: 0.32rem;
    padding-bottom: 0.27rem;
    border-top: 1px dotted rgba(42, 31, 65, 0.2);
    max-width: 15.6rem;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding-left: 0.72rem;
    padding-right: 0.72rem;
}
.footer-copy {
    font-size: 0.12rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: #6b7280;
}
.footer-contact {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding-right: 0.4rem;
}
.footer-contact .footer-link {
    color: #3e50f7;
    text-decoration: none;
}
.footer-contact .footer-link:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
}
.footer .mb-16 {
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}

/* ── Mini modal ── */
.mini-modal-trigger {
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-decoration-style: dotted;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
    text-decoration-color: #9ca3af;
}
.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; }
.mini-modal {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.2rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 4px 6px 14px 0 rgba(42, 31, 65, 0.16);
    z-index: 100;
    width: 3.2rem;
    max-width: 3.2rem;
}
.mini-modal--open { display: block; }
.mini-modal__title {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #25224a;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
    white-space: normal;
    text-transform: none;
}
.mini-modal__text {
    font-weight: 400;
    font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-transform: none;
    white-space: break-spaces;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0.1rem;
    right: 0.1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0.04rem;
    line-height: 1;
    font-size: 0.16rem;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close:hover { color: #25224a; }
.mini-modal__link {
    display: inline;
    color: #3e50f7;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: 500;
}
.mini-modal__link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.mini-modal-bg {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    z-index: 99;
}
.mini-modal-bg--open { display: block; }
/* Hero labels — white text needs white dotted underline */
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger { text-decoration-color: rgba(164, 161, 203, 0.5); }
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger:hover,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: #a4a1cb; }
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger .mini-modal,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger .mini-modal { white-space: normal; }

/* ── Shake animation ── */
.shaker {
    animation: shake 1s cubic-bezier(0.36, 0.07, 0.19, 0.97) both;
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    backface-visibility: hidden;
    perspective: 1000px;
}
@keyframes shake {
    10%, 90% { transform: translate3d(-1px, 0, 0); }
    20%, 80% { transform: translate3d(2px, 0, 0); }
    30%, 50%, 70% { transform: translate3d(-4px, 0, 0); }
    40%, 60% { transform: translate3d(4px, 0, 0); }
}
.section__blur, .sidebar-section__blur { cursor: pointer; }

/* ── Mobile CTA bar ── */
.mobile-cta-bar { display: none; }

                    <h1 class="listing-headline">Viral reel creator app that transforms photos and videos into high-performing content in minutes</h1>
                    <div class="expandable-text with-margin-bottom">
        <div class="listing-desc listing-desc--truncated" id="desc-main">A fast-growing iOS app that turns photos and videos into high-performing reels in minutes. Loved by creators, influencers, and hobbyists, it offers studio-quality templates and exports with zero learning curve. Built for viral results, it powered 150K reel exports and 100K edits in the last year.

Lean, profitable, and simple to run: ~43K downloads LTM, 1.5K MAU, 67 paying subscribers, and a 1,000% revenue lift. With ~$0 operating costs and automated flows, it runs almost hands-free—great as a cash-flow asset or springboard for a larger creator-tools play.

Key Highlights
✅ 100% organic growth; no paid UA to date
✅ $5.9K TTM revenue, $5.4K TTM profit; 200% YoY growth; last month profit $596
✅ Freemium + subscriptions (Weekly $7.99, Yearly $34.99) with room to lift conversion
✅ Engaged audience via App Store + Instagram
✅ Clear levers: more templates, bespoke packs, influencer/affiliate, SEO, ads
✅ Low-maintenance native iOS app; backend keeps content fresh automatically
✅ Affordable $16K entry for a profitable, bootstrapped asset</div>

    if (window.innerWidth > 1024) {
        var rect = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
        modal.style.top = (rect.bottom + 8) + 'px';
        modal.style.left = rect.left + 'px';
    } else {
        modal.style.top = '';
        modal.style.left = '';
    }
    modal.classList.add('mini-modal--open');
    activeMiniModal = modal;
    if (!miniModalBg) {
        miniModalBg = document.createElement('div');
        miniModalBg.className = 'mini-modal-bg';
        miniModalBg.addEventListener('click', function () { closeMiniModal(); });
        document.body.appendChild(miniModalBg);
    }
    miniModalBg.classList.add('mini-modal-bg--open');
}

    if (e) { e.stopPropagation(); }
    if (activeMiniModal) {

        activeMiniModal = null;

        setTimeout(function () { cta.classList.remove('shaker'); }, 1000);

}

    padding: 0.08rem 0.23rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    color: #6b7280;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: background 0.3s;
}
.nav-menu-dropdown__item--primary { color: #25224a; font-weight: 500; }
.nav-menu-dropdown__item:hover { background: #f5f4f8; }

/* ── Container ── */
.container { max-width: 15.6rem; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0.24rem 0.72rem 0.72rem; }

/* ── Hero ── */
.hero {
    background: linear-gradient(45deg, #1e1b3b 40%, #2f2b6d 60%);
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    padding: 0.4rem;
    color: #fff;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}
.hero__top { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; }
.hero__category { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.08rem; }
.hero__category-text { font-size: 0.12rem; color: #a4a1cb; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.3px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.04rem; }
.hero__category-text svg { width: 0.18rem; height: 0.18rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.hero__category-text a { color: #a4a1cb; text-decoration: underline; }
.hero__location { font-size: 0.12rem; line-height: 0.18rem; color: #a4a1cb; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.3px; margin-left: 0.16rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.04rem; }
.hero__location svg { width: 0.18rem; height: 0.18rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.hero__name-blocker {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.1rem;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #3c377f 10%, #6b63e5 70%, #3c377f 100%);
    border: 1px solid #4b45a0;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    padding: 0.12rem 0.52rem;
    margin: 0.16rem auto;
}
.hero__name-blocker svg { width: 0.16rem; height: 0.16rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.hero__name-blocker span { font-size: 0.14rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 0.24rem; color: #fff; }
.hero__headline {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.24rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: #a4a1cb;
    text-align: center;
    max-width: 5.72rem;
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
}
.hero__badges { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 0.04rem; margin-top: 0.16rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.badge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.04rem;
    background: #27245b;
    border: 1px solid #4b45a0;
    padding: .08rem .12rem;
    border-radius: .9rem;       
    font-size: 0.12rem;
    line-height: 0.18rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #fff;
}
.badge svg { width: 0.16rem; height: 0.16rem; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* ── Hero bottom: metrics + CTA ── */
.hero__bottom { display: flex; gap: 0.4rem; margin-top: 0.32rem; }

/* ── Metrics column ── */
.metrics-col { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.metrics-card {
    background: #3c377f;
    border-radius: 0.1rem;
    border: 1px solid #4b45a0;
    padding: 0.3rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.1rem;
}
.metrics-card:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.metrics-card__row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; }
.metrics-card__divider { width: 1px; align-self: stretch; background: #4b45a0; margin: 0 0.2rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.metrics-card__label { font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 700; color: #a4a1cb; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-bottom: 0.08rem; white-space: nowrap; }
.metrics-card__value { font-size: 0.18rem; line-height: 0.24rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; white-space: nowrap; }

/* Revenue bars */
.rev-row { margin-bottom: 0.38rem; }
.rev-row:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.rev-header { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; margin-bottom: 0.12rem; }
.rev-header__col { width: 1.4rem; margin-right: 0.25rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.rev-header__label { font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; color: #a4a1cb; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-bottom: 0.06rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.06rem; }
.rev-header__label::before { content: ""; display: inline-block; width: 0.08rem; height: 0.08rem; border-radius: 0.02rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.rev-header__label--revenue::before { background: #5650AC; }
.rev-header__label--profit-ttm::before { background: #7EDC72; }
.rev-header__label--profit-lm::before { background: #72BCDC; }
.rev-header__value { font-size: 0.2rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; line-height: 1.2; white-space: nowrap; }
.rev-bar {
    height: 0.1rem;
    border-radius: 0.22rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    background:
        repeating-linear-gradient(
            135deg,
            #5650AC 0 .28rem,
            #4B4696 0 .33rem
        ) 0 / 100%;
}
.rev-bar__fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 0.22rem; }

/* ── CTA column (hero) ── */
.cta-col { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.cta-card {
    border: 1px dashed #6b66b6;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    background: linear-gradient(45deg, #2F2B6D 60%, #1E1B3B 100%);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;
    height: 100%;
    padding: 0 1.06rem;
    width: 5.88rem;
    height: 3.42rem;
}
.cta-card__icon { display: flex; height: 0.3rem; margin-bottom: 0.26rem; }
.cta-card__title { font-size: 0.18rem; line-height: 0.24rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 11px; }
.cta-card__desc { font-size: 0.16rem; color: #a4a1cb; margin-bottom: 0.28rem; line-height: 0.24rem; }
.cta-card__btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    width: 2.54rem;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.08rem;
    padding: 0.16rem 0.26rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 0 0.09rem 0.09rem;
    font-size: 0.13rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #000;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: opacity 0.2s;
}
.cta-card__btn:hover { opacity: 0.85; text-decoration: none; }

/* ── Content area ── */
.content { display: flex; gap: 0.16rem; }
.content__left { 
    padding: 0.1rem; 
    flex: 5; 
    min-width: 0; 
    background: #fff; 
    border-radius: 0.09rem; 
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    max-width: 8rem;
}
.content__right { width: 4.76rem; }

/* ── Sections ── */
.section {
    padding: 0 0.3rem 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
.section__header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.09rem;
    padding: 0.2rem 0;
    margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
    border-bottom: 0.02rem solid #f0f0f5;
    background: #f5f7ff;
    border-radius: 0.06rem;
    padding: 0.3rem;
    margin: 0 -0.3rem 0.4rem;
    border-bottom: none;
}
.section__title { font-size: 0.16rem; line-height: 0.21rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; }
.section__updated { font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 500; color: #7f798d; margin-left: auto; }
.section__provider-logo { height: 0.26rem; width: auto; margin-left: 0.06rem; }
.section__category-badge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.06rem;
    font-size: 0.16rem;
    font-weight: 700;
}
.section__location { font-size: 0.14rem; color: #7f798d; margin-left: 0.12rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.04rem; }
.section__location svg { width: 0.14rem; height: 0.14rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.section__location svg path { fill: #7f798d; }
.section__blur {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 0 -0.32rem;
}
.section__blur img {
    width: 100%;
    display: block;
}

.listing-headline { font-size: 0.16rem; font-weight: 500; color: #25224a; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; line-height: 1.4; }
.listing-desc { font-size: 0.14rem; color: #464154; line-height: 0.22rem; white-space: pre-line; margin-bottom: 0.24rem; }
.listing-label { font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 700; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-bottom: 0.08rem; }
.listing-label__double-margin { margin-bottom: 0.16rem; }
.listing-value { font-size: 0.18rem; line-height: 0.24rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; }
.listing-value__underlined { border-bottom: 1px dotted #7F798D; }

.price-row { display: flex; gap: 0.7rem; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }

/* ── Performance ── */
.perf-grid { display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 0.7rem; }
.perf-item { text-align: left; }
.perf-label { width: fit-content; display: block; font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 600; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-bottom: 0.08rem; }
.perf-value { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.06rem; font-size: 0.14rem; line-height: 0.25rem; font-weight: 500; color: #25224a; }
.perf-value svg { width: 0.24rem; height: 0.24rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.perf-value__mobile { display: none; }

/* ── Expandable text wrapper ── */
.expandable-text {
    margin-top: 0.16rem;

    &.with-margin-bottom {
        margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    }
}
.expandable-text .listing-desc,
.expandable-text .company-field__value {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
.company-field .expandable-text {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* ── Truncated description with See more ── */
.listing-desc--truncated {
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    white-space: normal;
}
.see-more-link {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.04rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #1b1625;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin-top: 0.08rem;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 0.02rem;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0;
    font-family: inherit;
}
.see-more-link svg {
    transition: transform 0.2s ease;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}
.see-more-link.expanded svg {
    transform: rotate(180deg);
}

/* ── Price reduced badge ── */
.price-reduced-badge {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.06rem;
    padding: 0.06rem 0.12rem;
    border-radius: 0.04rem;
    border: 1px solid #3E50F7;
    background: #EEF2FE;           
    font-size: 0.1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #3E50F7;
    white-space: nowrap;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

/* ── Category icon card container ── */
.type-card__icon {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-width: 0.44rem;
    width: 0.44rem;
    height: 0.44rem;
    border-radius: 0.1rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    background: #fff;
}
.type-card__icon svg {
    width: 0.24rem;
    height: 0.24rem;
}

/* ── Annual snapshot table ── */
.annual-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
.annual-table th { font-size: 0.11rem; font-weight: 600; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: left; padding: 0.12rem 0.16rem; border-bottom: 0.02rem solid #f0f0f5; }
.annual-table td { font-size: 0.14rem; padding: 0.14rem 0.16rem; border-bottom: 0.01rem solid #f0f0f5; color: #25224a; }
.annual-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }

/* ── Blurred section (chart placeholder with lock) ── */
.blurred-section {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f0eef7, #e8e6f0);
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}
.blurred-section--chart {
    min-height: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.blurred-section--sidebar {
    min-height: 0.08rem;
}
.blurred-section::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(
        0deg,
        transparent,
        transparent 0.3rem,
        rgba(62, 80, 247, 0.03) 0.3rem,
        rgba(62, 80, 247, 0.03) 0.31rem
    );
    pointer-events: none;
}
.blurred-section svg {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* ── Metrics top row (customer metrics visible values) ── */
.metrics-top-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 0.2rem 0.3rem;
}
.metrics-top-item {
    position: relative;
    margin: 0 0 0.2rem;
    border-right: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
}
.metrics-top-item .listing-label {
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n),
.metrics-top-item:last-child {
    border-right: none;
}
/* Last row: no bottom margin (margin only separates rows). */
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):nth-last-child(-n + 4),
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):nth-last-child(-n + 4) ~ .metrics-top-item {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
/* Spacing below the grid only when the locked-chart blur follows it. */
.metrics-top-row + .section__blur {
    margin-top: 0.2rem;
}
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):not(:first-child)::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: -0.2rem;
    left: 0;
    width: calc(4 * 100% + 3 * 0.3rem);
    border-top: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
}
.metrics-top-value {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.08rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    color: #25224a;
}
.metrics-top-value svg { width: 0.24rem; height: 0.24rem; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* ── Bullet list ── */
.bullet-list {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.08rem;
}
.bullet-list li {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.1rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    color: #25224a;
    line-height: 1.5;
}
.bullet-list li::before {
    content: "";
    display: inline-block;
    width: 0.06rem;
    height: 0.06rem;
    min-width: 0.06rem;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #3e50f7;
    margin-top: 0.07rem;
}

/* ── Company field ── */
.companiey-fields-row { 
    display: flex; 
    flex-direction: row; 
    gap: 0.7rem; 
}
.company-field {
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;

    &.no-margin-bottom {
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }
}
.company-field__value {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    color: #25224a;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
}
.company-field__value--truncated {
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 4;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* ── Highlight cards ── */
.highlight-cards {
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    padding: 0.4rem;
}
.highlight-card {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.16rem;
    align-items: flex-start;
    margin-bottom: 0.28rem;
    &:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
}
.highlight-card__text { flex: 1; }
.highlight-card__title {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #25224a;
    margin-bottom: 0.04rem;
}
.highlight-card__desc {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: #464154;
}

/* ── Right sidebar ── */
.private-info-block {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    padding: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.sidebar-section { 
    margin-bottom: 0.32rem;
    &:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
}
.sidebar-section__title { font-size: 0.18rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; }
.sidebar-section__blur {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 0 -0.2rem;
}
.sidebar-section__blur img {
    width: 100%;
    display: block;
}
.sidebar-section__lock {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 2;
    color: #3e50f7;
    font-size: 0.24rem;
}
.sidebar-section__lock svg { width: 0.3rem; height: 0.3rem; }

/* ── Bottom banner ── */
.bottom-banner {
    background: radial-gradient(155.37% 120.73% at 94.83% 5.59%, #2f2b6d 55.35%, #1e1b3b);
    border-radius: 0.2rem;
    padding: 0.7rem 2.78rem;
    text-align: center;
    color: #fff;
    margin-top: 0.24rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
}
.bottom-banner__title { font-size: 0.32rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 0.1rem; line-height: 120%; }
.bottom-banner__desc { font-size: 0.14rem; font-weight: 400; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 0.24rem; }
.bottom-banner__features {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0;
    margin-top: 0.32rem;
    background: #3c377f;
    border: 1px solid #4b45a0;
    border-radius: 0.1rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    width: 100%;
}
.bottom-banner__feature {
    flex: 1;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 0.24rem 0.2rem;
}
.bottom-banner__feature-icon { display: flex; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; justify-content: center; }
.bottom-banner__feature-title {
    font-size: 0.1rem;
    line-height: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #9995C1;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    margin-bottom: 0.06rem;
}
.bottom-banner__feature-text { font-size: 0.12rem; color: #fff; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 700; }
.bottom-banner__feature-divider { display: none; }

/* ── Footer ── */
.footer {
    margin-top: auto;
}
.footer-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding-top: 0.32rem;
    padding-bottom: 0.27rem;
    border-top: 1px dotted rgba(42, 31, 65, 0.2);
    max-width: 15.6rem;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding-left: 0.72rem;
    padding-right: 0.72rem;
}
.footer-copy {
    font-size: 0.12rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: #6b7280;
}
.footer-contact {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding-right: 0.4rem;
}
.footer-contact .footer-link {
    color: #3e50f7;
    text-decoration: none;
}
.footer-contact .footer-link:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
}
.footer .mb-16 {
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}

/* ── Mini modal ── */
.mini-modal-trigger {
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-decoration-style: dotted;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
    text-decoration-color: #9ca3af;
}
.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; }
.mini-modal {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.2rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 4px 6px 14px 0 rgba(42, 31, 65, 0.16);
    z-index: 100;
    width: 3.2rem;
    max-width: 3.2rem;
}
.mini-modal--open { display: block; }
.mini-modal__title {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #25224a;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
    white-space: normal;
    text-transform: none;
}
.mini-modal__text {
    font-weight: 400;
    font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-transform: none;
    white-space: break-spaces;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0.1rem;
    right: 0.1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0.04rem;
    line-height: 1;
    font-size: 0.16rem;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close:hover { color: #25224a; }
.mini-modal__link {
    display: inline;
    color: #3e50f7;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: 500;
}
.mini-modal__link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.mini-modal-bg {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    z-index: 99;
}
.mini-modal-bg--open { display: block; }
/* Hero labels — white text needs white dotted underline */
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger { text-decoration-color: rgba(164, 161, 203, 0.5); }
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger:hover,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: #a4a1cb; }
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger .mini-modal,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger .mini-modal { white-space: normal; }

/* ── Shake animation ── */
.shaker {
    animation: shake 1s cubic-bezier(0.36, 0.07, 0.19, 0.97) both;
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);

                    <h1 class="listing-headline">CRM Tool for Faster Deal Closures on WhatsApp & Telegram Web</h1>
                    <div class="expandable-text with-margin-bottom">
        <div class="listing-desc listing-desc--truncated" id="desc-main">This lightweight CRM integration helps sales professionals save time and close more deals by seamlessly connecting with WhatsApp Web and Telegram Web. It’s designed for simplicity, especially in markets where WhatsApp usage is on the rise. The platform runs at very low cost, generates nearly passive income, and offers a clear path to expand with more advanced features as needed.

✅ Seamless CRM integration with WhatsApp Web and Telegram Web
✅ Built for fast-paced messaging and deal closures
✅ Loyal customer base in the expanding WhatsApp market
✅ Extremely low operating costs
✅ Generates almost entirely passive income
✅ Scalable opportunity to introduce advanced CRM features</div>

var activeMiniModal = null;

function openMiniModal(trigger) {
    closeMiniModal();
    var modal = trigger.querySelector('.mini-modal');
    if (!modal) return;
    if (window.innerWidth > 1024) {
        var rect = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
        modal.style.top = (rect.bottom + 8) + 'px';
        modal.style.left = rect.left + 'px';
    } else {
        modal.style.top = '';
        modal.style.left = '';

    modal.classList.add('mini-modal--open');
    activeMiniModal = modal;
    if (!miniModalBg) {
        miniModalBg = document.createElement('div');
        miniModalBg.className = 'mini-modal-bg';
        miniModalBg.addEventListener('click', function () { closeMiniModal(); });
        document.body.appendChild(miniModalBg);
    }
    miniModalBg.classList.add('mini-modal-bg--open');
}
function closeMiniModal(e) {
    if (e) { e.stopPropagation(); }
    if (activeMiniModal) {
        activeMiniModal.classList.remove('mini-modal--open');

function scrollToCtaAndShake() {

    var rect = cta.getBoundingClientRect();
    var scrollTop = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
    window.scrollTo({ top: rect.top + scrollTop - 100, behavior: 'smooth' });
    setTimeout(function () {
        cta.classList.add('shaker');
        setTimeout(function () { cta.classList.remove('shaker'); }, 1000);
    }, 400);
}

    });
});

/* ── Blurred section (chart placeholder with lock) ── */

.blurred-section--chart {
    min-height: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.blurred-section--sidebar {
    min-height: 0.08rem;
}
.blurred-section::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(
        0deg,
        transparent,
        transparent 0.3rem,
        rgba(62, 80, 247, 0.03) 0.3rem,
        rgba(62, 80, 247, 0.03) 0.31rem

}
.blurred-section svg {

}
.metrics-top-item {

    border-right: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;

}
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n),
.metrics-top-item:last-child {
    border-right: none;
}
/* Last row: no bottom margin (margin only separates rows). */
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):nth-last-child(-n + 4),
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):nth-last-child(-n + 4) ~ .metrics-top-item {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
/* Spacing below the grid only when the locked-chart blur follows it. */
.metrics-top-row + .section__blur {
    margin-top: 0.2rem;
}
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):not(:first-child)::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: -0.2rem;
    left: 0;
    width: calc(4 * 100% + 3 * 0.3rem);
    border-top: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
}
.metrics-top-value {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.08rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 500;

/* ── Mini modal ── */
.mini-modal-trigger {
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-decoration-style: dotted;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
    text-decoration-color: #9ca3af;
}
.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; }
.mini-modal {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.2rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 4px 6px 14px 0 rgba(42, 31, 65, 0.16);
    z-index: 100;
    width: 3.2rem;
    max-width: 3.2rem;
}
.mini-modal--open { display: block; }
.mini-modal__title {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #25224a;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
    white-space: normal;
    text-transform: none;
}
.mini-modal__text {
    font-weight: 400;
    font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-transform: none;
    white-space: break-spaces;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0.1rem;
    right: 0.1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0.04rem;
    line-height: 1;
    font-size: 0.16rem;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close:hover { color: #25224a; }
.mini-modal__link {
    display: inline;
    color: #3e50f7;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: 500;
}
.mini-modal__link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.mini-modal-bg {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    z-index: 99;
}
.mini-modal-bg--open { display: block; }
/* Hero labels — white text needs white dotted underline */
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger { text-decoration-color: rgba(164, 161, 203, 0.5); }
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger:hover,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: #a4a1cb; }
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger .mini-modal,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger .mini-modal { white-space: normal; }

/* ── Shake animation ── */
.shaker {
    animation: shake 1s cubic-bezier(0.36, 0.07, 0.19, 0.97) both;
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    backface-visibility: hidden;
    perspective: 1000px;
}
@keyframes shake {
    10%, 90% { transform: translate3d(-1px, 0, 0); }
    20%, 80% { transform: translate3d(2px, 0, 0); }
    30%, 50%, 70% { transform: translate3d(-4px, 0, 0); }
    40%, 60% { transform: translate3d(4px, 0, 0); }
}
.section__blur, .sidebar-section__blur { cursor: pointer; }

                    <h1 class="listing-headline">Form builder tool for Canva users to create customizable forms and embedded widgets for websites.</h1>
                    <div class="expandable-text with-margin-bottom">
        <div class="listing-desc listing-desc--truncated" id="desc-main">This business is a form builder and interactive widget suite purpose-built for Canva websites. Users create beautiful forms, collect and showcase testimonials, and track performance with clear analytics—no code, fully brandable, and fast to embed.

Profitable and simple to operate, it serves 100–250 customers from solo creators to enterprises, including teams at a leading design platform. It’s a focused niche with strong product–market fit among Canva site owners.

Key Highlights
✅ TTM revenue $38,399 with $30,477 profit; ARR $37,671; 4% growth
✅ Last month: $3,641 revenue / $3,148 profit
✅ Bootstrapped, recurring subscription + freemium model
✅ Niche advantage vs general tools (Jotform, Tally) by being built for Canva
✅ 100–250 customers; lean, solo-run operations and low overhead
✅ Easy expansion: SEO, content, social, and conversion optimization
✅ Upside from new features and premium analytics/widgets
✅ Ideal bolt-on for an agency, no-code portfolio, or micro-SaaS operator</div>

function toggleDesc(id, btn) {

    var textNode = btn.firstChild;
    if (expanded) {
        desc.classList.add('listing-desc--truncated');
        btn.classList.remove('expanded');

        textNode.textContent = 'See less ';
    }
}
var activeMiniModal = null;
var miniModalBg = null;
function openMiniModal(trigger) {
    closeMiniModal();
    var modal = trigger.querySelector('.mini-modal');
    if (!modal) return;
    if (window.innerWidth > 1024) {
        var rect = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
        modal.style.top = (rect.bottom + 8) + 'px';
        modal.style.left = rect.left + 'px';
    } else {
        modal.style.top = '';
        modal.style.left = '';
    }
    modal.classList.add('mini-modal--open');
    activeMiniModal = modal;
    if (!miniModalBg) {
        miniModalBg = document.createElement('div');
        miniModalBg.className = 'mini-modal-bg';
        miniModalBg.addEventListener('click', function () { closeMiniModal(); });
        document.body.appendChild(miniModalBg);
    }
    miniModalBg.classList.add('mini-modal-bg--open');
}
function closeMiniModal(e) {
    if (e) { e.stopPropagation(); }
    if (activeMiniModal) {
        activeMiniModal.classList.remove('mini-modal--open');
        activeMiniModal = null;
    }
    if (miniModalBg) { miniModalBg.classList.remove('mini-modal-bg--open'); }
}
function scrollToCtaAndShake() {
    var cta = document.querySelector('.cta-card');
    if (!cta) return;
    var rect = cta.getBoundingClientRect();
    var scrollTop = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
    window.scrollTo({ top: rect.top + scrollTop - 100, behavior: 'smooth' });
    setTimeout(function () {
        cta.classList.add('shaker');
        setTimeout(function () { cta.classList.remove('shaker'); }, 1000);
    }, 400);
}
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-expandable]').forEach(function (btn) {
        var id = btn.getAttribute('data-expandable');
        var desc = document.getElementById(id);

            btn.style.display = 'none';

    document.querySelectorAll('.section__blur, .sidebar-section__blur').forEach(function (el) {
        el.addEventListener('click', scrollToCtaAndShake);

            e.stopPropagation();
            if (activeMiniModal && activeMiniModal.parentElement === trigger) {
                closeMiniModal();
            } else {
                openMiniModal(trigger);
            }
        });
    });
});

    max-width: 8rem;
}
.content__right { width: 4.76rem; }

/* ── Sections ── */
.section {
    padding: 0 0.3rem 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
.section__header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.09rem;
    padding: 0.2rem 0;
    margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
    border-bottom: 0.02rem solid #f0f0f5;
    background: #f5f7ff;
    border-radius: 0.06rem;
    padding: 0.3rem;
    margin: 0 -0.3rem 0.4rem;
    border-bottom: none;
}
.section__title { font-size: 0.16rem; line-height: 0.21rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; }
.section__updated { font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 500; color: #7f798d; margin-left: auto; }
.section__provider-logo { height: 0.26rem; width: auto; margin-left: 0.06rem; }
.section__category-badge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.06rem;
    font-size: 0.16rem;
    font-weight: 700;
}
.section__location { font-size: 0.14rem; color: #7f798d; margin-left: 0.12rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.04rem; }
.section__location svg { width: 0.14rem; height: 0.14rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.section__location svg path { fill: #7f798d; }
.section__blur {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 0 -0.32rem;
}
.section__blur img {
    width: 100%;
    display: block;
}

.listing-headline { font-size: 0.16rem; font-weight: 500; color: #25224a; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; line-height: 1.4; }
.listing-desc { font-size: 0.14rem; color: #464154; line-height: 0.22rem; white-space: pre-line; margin-bottom: 0.24rem; }
.listing-label { font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 700; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-bottom: 0.08rem; }
.listing-label__double-margin { margin-bottom: 0.16rem; }
.listing-value { font-size: 0.18rem; line-height: 0.24rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; }
.listing-value__underlined { border-bottom: 1px dotted #7F798D; }

.price-row { display: flex; gap: 0.7rem; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }

/* ── Performance ── */
.perf-grid { display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 0.7rem; }
.perf-item { text-align: left; }
.perf-label { width: fit-content; display: block; font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 600; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-bottom: 0.08rem; }
.perf-value { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.06rem; font-size: 0.14rem; line-height: 0.25rem; font-weight: 500; color: #25224a; }
.perf-value svg { width: 0.24rem; height: 0.24rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.perf-value__mobile { display: none; }

/* ── Expandable text wrapper ── */
.expandable-text {
    margin-top: 0.16rem;

    &.with-margin-bottom {
        margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    }
}
.expandable-text .listing-desc,
.expandable-text .company-field__value {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
.company-field .expandable-text {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* ── Truncated description with See more ── */
.listing-desc--truncated {
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    white-space: normal;
}
.see-more-link {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.04rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #1b1625;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin-top: 0.08rem;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 0.02rem;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0;
    font-family: inherit;
}
.see-more-link svg {
    transition: transform 0.2s ease;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}
.see-more-link.expanded svg {
    transform: rotate(180deg);
}

/* ── Price reduced badge ── */
.price-reduced-badge {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.06rem;
    padding: 0.06rem 0.12rem;
    border-radius: 0.04rem;
    border: 1px solid #3E50F7;
    background: #EEF2FE;           
    font-size: 0.1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #3E50F7;
    white-space: nowrap;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

/* ── Category icon card container ── */
.type-card__icon {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-width: 0.44rem;
    width: 0.44rem;
    height: 0.44rem;
    border-radius: 0.1rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    background: #fff;
}
.type-card__icon svg {
    width: 0.24rem;
    height: 0.24rem;
}

/* ── Annual snapshot table ── */
.annual-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
.annual-table th { font-size: 0.11rem; font-weight: 600; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: left; padding: 0.12rem 0.16rem; border-bottom: 0.02rem solid #f0f0f5; }
.annual-table td { font-size: 0.14rem; padding: 0.14rem 0.16rem; border-bottom: 0.01rem solid #f0f0f5; color: #25224a; }
.annual-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }

/* ── Blurred section (chart placeholder with lock) ── */
.blurred-section {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f0eef7, #e8e6f0);
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}
.blurred-section--chart {
    min-height: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.blurred-section--sidebar {
    min-height: 0.08rem;
}
.blurred-section::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(
        0deg,
        transparent,
        transparent 0.3rem,
        rgba(62, 80, 247, 0.03) 0.3rem,
        rgba(62, 80, 247, 0.03) 0.31rem
    );
    pointer-events: none;
}
.blurred-section svg {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* ── Metrics top row (customer metrics visible values) ── */
.metrics-top-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 0.2rem 0.3rem;
}
.metrics-top-item {
    position: relative;
    margin: 0 0 0.2rem;
    border-right: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
}
.metrics-top-item .listing-label {
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n),
.metrics-top-item:last-child {
    border-right: none;
}
/* Last row: no bottom margin (margin only separates rows). */
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):nth-last-child(-n + 4),
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):nth-last-child(-n + 4) ~ .metrics-top-item {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
/* Spacing below the grid only when the locked-chart blur follows it. */
.metrics-top-row + .section__blur {
    margin-top: 0.2rem;
}
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):not(:first-child)::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: -0.2rem;
    left: 0;
    width: calc(4 * 100% + 3 * 0.3rem);
    border-top: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
}
.metrics-top-value {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.08rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    color: #25224a;
}
.metrics-top-value svg { width: 0.24rem; height: 0.24rem; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* ── Bullet list ── */
.bullet-list {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.08rem;
}
.bullet-list li {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.1rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    color: #25224a;
    line-height: 1.5;
}
.bullet-list li::before {
    content: "";
    display: inline-block;
    width: 0.06rem;
    height: 0.06rem;
    min-width: 0.06rem;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #3e50f7;
    margin-top: 0.07rem;
}

/* ── Company field ── */
.companiey-fields-row { 
    display: flex; 
    flex-direction: row; 
    gap: 0.7rem; 
}
.company-field {
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;

    &.no-margin-bottom {
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }
}
.company-field__value {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    color: #25224a;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
}
.company-field__value--truncated {
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 4;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* ── Highlight cards ── */
.highlight-cards {
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    padding: 0.4rem;
}
.highlight-card {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.16rem;
    align-items: flex-start;
    margin-bottom: 0.28rem;
    &:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
}
.highlight-card__text { flex: 1; }
.highlight-card__title {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #25224a;
    margin-bottom: 0.04rem;
}
.highlight-card__desc {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: #464154;
}

/* ── Right sidebar ── */
.private-info-block {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    padding: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.sidebar-section { 
    margin-bottom: 0.32rem;
    &:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
}
.sidebar-section__title { font-size: 0.18rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; }
.sidebar-section__blur {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 0 -0.2rem;
}
.sidebar-section__blur img {
    width: 100%;
    display: block;
}
.sidebar-section__lock {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 2;
    color: #3e50f7;
    font-size: 0.24rem;
}
.sidebar-section__lock svg { width: 0.3rem; height: 0.3rem; }

/* ── Bottom banner ── */
.bottom-banner {
    background: radial-gradient(155.37% 120.73% at 94.83% 5.59%, #2f2b6d 55.35%, #1e1b3b);
    border-radius: 0.2rem;
    padding: 0.7rem 2.78rem;
    text-align: center;
    color: #fff;
    margin-top: 0.24rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
}
.bottom-banner__title { font-size: 0.32rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 0.1rem; line-height: 120%; }
.bottom-banner__desc { font-size: 0.14rem; font-weight: 400; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 0.24rem; }
.bottom-banner__features {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0;
    margin-top: 0.32rem;
    background: #3c377f;
    border: 1px solid #4b45a0;
    border-radius: 0.1rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    width: 100%;
}
.bottom-banner__feature {
    flex: 1;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 0.24rem 0.2rem;
}
.bottom-banner__feature-icon { display: flex; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; justify-content: center; }
.bottom-banner__feature-title {
    font-size: 0.1rem;
    line-height: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #9995C1;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    margin-bottom: 0.06rem;
}
.bottom-banner__feature-text { font-size: 0.12rem; color: #fff; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 700; }
.bottom-banner__feature-divider { display: none; }

/* ── Footer ── */
.footer {
    margin-top: auto;
}
.footer-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding-top: 0.32rem;
    padding-bottom: 0.27rem;
    border-top: 1px dotted rgba(42, 31, 65, 0.2);
    max-width: 15.6rem;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding-left: 0.72rem;
    padding-right: 0.72rem;
}
.footer-copy {
    font-size: 0.12rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: #6b7280;
}
.footer-contact {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding-right: 0.4rem;
}
.footer-contact .footer-link {
    color: #3e50f7;
    text-decoration: none;
}
.footer-contact .footer-link:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
}
.footer .mb-16 {
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}

/* ── Mini modal ── */
.mini-modal-trigger {
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-decoration-style: dotted;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
    text-decoration-color: #9ca3af;
}
.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; }
.mini-modal {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.2rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 4px 6px 14px 0 rgba(42, 31, 65, 0.16);
    z-index: 100;
    width: 3.2rem;
    max-width: 3.2rem;
}
.mini-modal--open { display: block; }
.mini-modal__title {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #25224a;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
    white-space: normal;
    text-transform: none;
}
.mini-modal__text {
    font-weight: 400;
    font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-transform: none;
    white-space: break-spaces;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0.1rem;
    right: 0.1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0.04rem;
    line-height: 1;
    font-size: 0.16rem;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close:hover { color: #25224a; }
.mini-modal__link {
    display: inline;
    color: #3e50f7;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: 500;
}
.mini-modal__link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.mini-modal-bg {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    z-index: 99;
}
.mini-modal-bg--open { display: block; }
/* Hero labels — white text needs white dotted underline */
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger { text-decoration-color: rgba(164, 161, 203, 0.5); }
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger:hover,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: #a4a1cb; }
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger .mini-modal,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger .mini-modal { white-space: normal; }

/* ── Shake animation ── */
.shaker {
    animation: shake 1s cubic-bezier(0.36, 0.07, 0.19, 0.97) both;
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    backface-visibility: hidden;
    perspective: 1000px;
}
@keyframes shake {
    10%, 90% { transform: translate3d(-1px, 0, 0); }
    20%, 80% { transform: translate3d(2px, 0, 0); }
    30%, 50%, 70% { transform: translate3d(-4px, 0, 0); }
    40%, 60% { transform: translate3d(4px, 0, 0); }
}
.section__blur, .sidebar-section__blur { cursor: pointer; }

/* ── Mobile CTA bar ── */
.mobile-cta-bar { display: none; }

                    <h1 class="listing-headline">Shopify quantity break and bundle app for increasing average order value</h1>
                    <div class="expandable-text with-margin-bottom">
        <div class="listing-desc listing-desc--truncated" id="desc-main">A Shopify application that helps merchants increase average order value through quantity discounts, product bundles, free gifts, and post-purchase upsells. The app is designed for quick installation and easy customization, with flexible styling and multilingual support to help merchants create higher-converting offers that match their storefront and customer base.

Key Highlights
✅ Shopify app focused on increasing average order value
✅ Supports quantity breaks and volume-based discounts
✅ Includes product bundles and free gift promotions
✅ Offers post-purchase upsell functionality
✅ Provides customizable styling options to match store branding
✅ Supports multiple languages and straightforward installation</div>

        modal.style.top = (rect.bottom + 8) + 'px';
        modal.style.left = rect.left + 'px';

        miniModalBg.addEventListener('click', function () { closeMiniModal(); });
        document.body.appendChild(miniModalBg);

}
function closeMiniModal(e) {

    var scrollTop = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop;

    setTimeout(function () {
        cta.classList.add('shaker');
        setTimeout(function () { cta.classList.remove('shaker'); }, 1000);
    }, 400);
}

    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 0 -0.32rem;
}
.section__blur img {
    width: 100%;
    display: block;
}

.listing-headline { font-size: 0.16rem; font-weight: 500; color: #25224a; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; line-height: 1.4; }
.listing-desc { font-size: 0.14rem; color: #464154; line-height: 0.22rem; white-space: pre-line; margin-bottom: 0.24rem; }
.listing-label { font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 700; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-bottom: 0.08rem; }
.listing-label__double-margin { margin-bottom: 0.16rem; }
.listing-value { font-size: 0.18rem; line-height: 0.24rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; }
.listing-value__underlined { border-bottom: 1px dotted #7F798D; }

.price-row { display: flex; gap: 0.7rem; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }

/* ── Performance ── */
.perf-grid { display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 0.7rem; }
.perf-item { text-align: left; }
.perf-label { width: fit-content; display: block; font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 600; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-bottom: 0.08rem; }
.perf-value { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.06rem; font-size: 0.14rem; line-height: 0.25rem; font-weight: 500; color: #25224a; }
.perf-value svg { width: 0.24rem; height: 0.24rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.perf-value__mobile { display: none; }

/* ── Expandable text wrapper ── */
.expandable-text {
    margin-top: 0.16rem;

    &.with-margin-bottom {
        margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    }
}
.expandable-text .listing-desc,
.expandable-text .company-field__value {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
.company-field .expandable-text {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* ── Truncated description with See more ── */
.listing-desc--truncated {
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    white-space: normal;
}
.see-more-link {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.04rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #1b1625;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin-top: 0.08rem;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 0.02rem;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0;
    font-family: inherit;
}
.see-more-link svg {
    transition: transform 0.2s ease;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}
.see-more-link.expanded svg {
    transform: rotate(180deg);
}

/* ── Price reduced badge ── */
.price-reduced-badge {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.06rem;
    padding: 0.06rem 0.12rem;
    border-radius: 0.04rem;
    border: 1px solid #3E50F7;
    background: #EEF2FE;           
    font-size: 0.1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #3E50F7;
    white-space: nowrap;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

/* ── Category icon card container ── */
.type-card__icon {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-width: 0.44rem;
    width: 0.44rem;
    height: 0.44rem;
    border-radius: 0.1rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    background: #fff;
}
.type-card__icon svg {
    width: 0.24rem;
    height: 0.24rem;
}

/* ── Annual snapshot table ── */
.annual-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
.annual-table th { font-size: 0.11rem; font-weight: 600; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: left; padding: 0.12rem 0.16rem; border-bottom: 0.02rem solid #f0f0f5; }
.annual-table td { font-size: 0.14rem; padding: 0.14rem 0.16rem; border-bottom: 0.01rem solid #f0f0f5; color: #25224a; }
.annual-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }

/* ── Blurred section (chart placeholder with lock) ── */
.blurred-section {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f0eef7, #e8e6f0);
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}
.blurred-section--chart {
    min-height: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.blurred-section--sidebar {
    min-height: 0.08rem;
}
.blurred-section::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(
        0deg,
        transparent,
        transparent 0.3rem,
        rgba(62, 80, 247, 0.03) 0.3rem,
        rgba(62, 80, 247, 0.03) 0.31rem
    );
    pointer-events: none;
}
.blurred-section svg {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* ── Metrics top row (customer metrics visible values) ── */
.metrics-top-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 0.2rem 0.3rem;
}
.metrics-top-item {
    position: relative;
    margin: 0 0 0.2rem;
    border-right: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
}
.metrics-top-item .listing-label {
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n),
.metrics-top-item:last-child {
    border-right: none;
}
/* Last row: no bottom margin (margin only separates rows). */
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):nth-last-child(-n + 4),
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):nth-last-child(-n + 4) ~ .metrics-top-item {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
/* Spacing below the grid only when the locked-chart blur follows it. */
.metrics-top-row + .section__blur {
    margin-top: 0.2rem;
}
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):not(:first-child)::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: -0.2rem;
    left: 0;
    width: calc(4 * 100% + 3 * 0.3rem);
    border-top: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
}
.metrics-top-value {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.08rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    color: #25224a;
}
.metrics-top-value svg { width: 0.24rem; height: 0.24rem; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* ── Bullet list ── */
.bullet-list {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.08rem;
}
.bullet-list li {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.1rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    color: #25224a;
    line-height: 1.5;
}
.bullet-list li::before {
    content: "";
    display: inline-block;
    width: 0.06rem;
    height: 0.06rem;
    min-width: 0.06rem;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #3e50f7;
    margin-top: 0.07rem;
}

/* ── Company field ── */
.companiey-fields-row { 
    display: flex; 
    flex-direction: row; 
    gap: 0.7rem; 
}
.company-field {
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;

    &.no-margin-bottom {
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }
}
.company-field__value {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    color: #25224a;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
}
.company-field__value--truncated {
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 4;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* ── Highlight cards ── */
.highlight-cards {
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    padding: 0.4rem;
}
.highlight-card {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.16rem;
    align-items: flex-start;
    margin-bottom: 0.28rem;
    &:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
}
.highlight-card__text { flex: 1; }
.highlight-card__title {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #25224a;
    margin-bottom: 0.04rem;
}
.highlight-card__desc {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: #464154;
}

/* ── Right sidebar ── */
.private-info-block {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    padding: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.sidebar-section { 
    margin-bottom: 0.32rem;
    &:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
}
.sidebar-section__title { font-size: 0.18rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; }
.sidebar-section__blur {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 0 -0.2rem;
}
.sidebar-section__blur img {
    width: 100%;
    display: block;
}
.sidebar-section__lock {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 2;
    color: #3e50f7;
    font-size: 0.24rem;
}
.sidebar-section__lock svg { width: 0.3rem; height: 0.3rem; }

/* ── Bottom banner ── */
.bottom-banner {
    background: radial-gradient(155.37% 120.73% at 94.83% 5.59%, #2f2b6d 55.35%, #1e1b3b);
    border-radius: 0.2rem;
    padding: 0.7rem 2.78rem;
    text-align: center;
    color: #fff;
    margin-top: 0.24rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
}
.bottom-banner__title { font-size: 0.32rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 0.1rem; line-height: 120%; }
.bottom-banner__desc { font-size: 0.14rem; font-weight: 400; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 0.24rem; }
.bottom-banner__features {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0;
    margin-top: 0.32rem;
    background: #3c377f;
    border: 1px solid #4b45a0;
    border-radius: 0.1rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    width: 100%;
}
.bottom-banner__feature {
    flex: 1;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 0.24rem 0.2rem;
}
.bottom-banner__feature-icon { display: flex; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; justify-content: center; }
.bottom-banner__feature-title {
    font-size: 0.1rem;
    line-height: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #9995C1;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    margin-bottom: 0.06rem;
}
.bottom-banner__feature-text { font-size: 0.12rem; color: #fff; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 700; }
.bottom-banner__feature-divider { display: none; }

/* ── Footer ── */
.footer {
    margin-top: auto;
}
.footer-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding-top: 0.32rem;
    padding-bottom: 0.27rem;
    border-top: 1px dotted rgba(42, 31, 65, 0.2);
    max-width: 15.6rem;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding-left: 0.72rem;
    padding-right: 0.72rem;
}
.footer-copy {
    font-size: 0.12rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: #6b7280;
}
.footer-contact {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding-right: 0.4rem;
}
.footer-contact .footer-link {
    color: #3e50f7;
    text-decoration: none;
}
.footer-contact .footer-link:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
}
.footer .mb-16 {
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}

/* ── Mini modal ── */
.mini-modal-trigger {
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-decoration-style: dotted;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
    text-decoration-color: #9ca3af;
}
.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; }
.mini-modal {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.2rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 4px 6px 14px 0 rgba(42, 31, 65, 0.16);
    z-index: 100;
    width: 3.2rem;
    max-width: 3.2rem;
}
.mini-modal--open { display: block; }
.mini-modal__title {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #25224a;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
    white-space: normal;
    text-transform: none;
}
.mini-modal__text {
    font-weight: 400;
    font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-transform: none;
    white-space: break-spaces;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0.1rem;
    right: 0.1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0.04rem;
    line-height: 1;
    font-size: 0.16rem;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close:hover { color: #25224a; }
.mini-modal__link {
    display: inline;
    color: #3e50f7;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: 500;
}
.mini-modal__link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.mini-modal-bg {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    z-index: 99;
}
.mini-modal-bg--open { display: block; }
/* Hero labels — white text needs white dotted underline */
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger { text-decoration-color: rgba(164, 161, 203, 0.5); }
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger:hover,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: #a4a1cb; }
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger .mini-modal,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger .mini-modal { white-space: normal; }

/* ── Shake animation ── */
.shaker {
    animation: shake 1s cubic-bezier(0.36, 0.07, 0.19, 0.97) both;
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    backface-visibility: hidden;
    perspective: 1000px;
}
@keyframes shake {
    10%, 90% { transform: translate3d(-1px, 0, 0); }
    20%, 80% { transform: translate3d(2px, 0, 0); }
    30%, 50%, 70% { transform: translate3d(-4px, 0, 0); }
    40%, 60% { transform: translate3d(4px, 0, 0); }
}
.section__blur, .sidebar-section__blur { cursor: pointer; }

/* ── Mobile CTA bar ── */
.mobile-cta-bar { display: none; }

var activeMiniModal = null;
var miniModalBg = null;
function openMiniModal(trigger) {
    closeMiniModal();
    var modal = trigger.querySelector('.mini-modal');
    if (!modal) return;
    if (window.innerWidth > 1024) {
        var rect = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
        modal.style.top = (rect.bottom + 8) + 'px';
        modal.style.left = rect.left + 'px';
    } else {
        modal.style.top = '';
        modal.style.left = '';
    }
    modal.classList.add('mini-modal--open');
    activeMiniModal = modal;
    if (!miniModalBg) {
        miniModalBg = document.createElement('div');
        miniModalBg.className = 'mini-modal-bg';
        miniModalBg.addEventListener('click', function () { closeMiniModal(); });
        document.body.appendChild(miniModalBg);
    }
    miniModalBg.classList.add('mini-modal-bg--open');
}
function closeMiniModal(e) {
    if (e) { e.stopPropagation(); }
    if (activeMiniModal) {
        activeMiniModal.classList.remove('mini-modal--open');
        activeMiniModal = null;
    }
    if (miniModalBg) { miniModalBg.classList.remove('mini-modal-bg--open'); }

function scrollToCtaAndShake() {
    var cta = document.querySelector('.cta-card');
    if (!cta) return;
    var rect = cta.getBoundingClientRect();
    var scrollTop = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
    window.scrollTo({ top: rect.top + scrollTop - 100, behavior: 'smooth' });
    setTimeout(function () {
        cta.classList.add('shaker');
        setTimeout(function () { cta.classList.remove('shaker'); }, 1000);
    }, 400);
}
