.rev-header__value { font-size: 0.2rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; line-height: 1.2; white-space: nowrap; }
.rev-bar {
    height: 0.1rem;
    border-radius: 0.22rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    background:
        repeating-linear-gradient(
            135deg,
            #5650AC 0 .28rem,
            #4B4696 0 .33rem
        ) 0 / 100%;
}
.rev-bar__fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 0.22rem; }

/* ── CTA column (hero) ── */
.cta-col { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.cta-card {
    border: 1px dashed #6b66b6;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    background: linear-gradient(45deg, #2F2B6D 60%, #1E1B3B 100%);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;
    height: 100%;
    padding: 0 1.06rem;
    width: 5.88rem;
    height: 3.42rem;
}
.cta-card__icon { display: flex; height: 0.3rem; margin-bottom: 0.26rem; }
.cta-card__title { font-size: 0.18rem; line-height: 0.24rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 11px; }
.cta-card__desc { font-size: 0.16rem; color: #a4a1cb; margin-bottom: 0.28rem; line-height: 0.24rem; }
.cta-card__btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    width: 2.54rem;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.08rem;
    padding: 0.16rem 0.26rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 0 0.09rem 0.09rem;
    font-size: 0.13rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #000;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: opacity 0.2s;
}
.cta-card__btn:hover { opacity: 0.85; text-decoration: none; }

/* ── Content area ── */
.content { display: flex; gap: 0.16rem; }
.content__left { 
    padding: 0.1rem; 
    flex: 5; 
    min-width: 0; 
    background: #fff; 
    border-radius: 0.09rem; 
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    max-width: 8rem;
}
.content__right { width: 4.76rem; }

/* ── Sections ── */
.section {
    padding: 0 0.3rem 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
.section__header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.09rem;
    padding: 0.2rem 0;
    margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
    border-bottom: 0.02rem solid #f0f0f5;
    background: #f5f7ff;
    border-radius: 0.06rem;
    padding: 0.3rem;
    margin: 0 -0.3rem 0.4rem;
    border-bottom: none;
}
.section__title { font-size: 0.16rem; line-height: 0.21rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; }
.section__updated { font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 500; color: #7f798d; margin-left: auto; }
.section__provider-logo { height: 0.26rem; width: auto; margin-left: 0.06rem; }
.section__category-badge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.06rem;
    font-size: 0.16rem;
    font-weight: 700;
}
.section__location { font-size: 0.14rem; color: #7f798d; margin-left: 0.12rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.04rem; }
.section__location svg { width: 0.14rem; height: 0.14rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.section__location svg path { fill: #7f798d; }
.section__blur {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 0 -0.32rem;
}
.section__blur img {
    width: 100%;
    display: block;
}

.listing-headline { font-size: 0.16rem; font-weight: 500; color: #25224a; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; line-height: 1.4; }
.listing-desc { font-size: 0.14rem; color: #464154; line-height: 0.22rem; white-space: pre-line; margin-bottom: 0.24rem; }
.listing-label { font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 700; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-bottom: 0.08rem; }
.listing-label__double-margin { margin-bottom: 0.16rem; }
.listing-value { font-size: 0.18rem; line-height: 0.24rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; }
.listing-value__underlined { border-bottom: 1px dotted #7F798D; }

.price-row { display: flex; gap: 0.7rem; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }

/* ── Performance ── */
.perf-grid { display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 0.7rem; }
.perf-item { text-align: left; }
.perf-label { width: fit-content; display: block; font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 600; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-bottom: 0.08rem; }
.perf-value { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.06rem; font-size: 0.14rem; line-height: 0.25rem; font-weight: 500; color: #25224a; }
.perf-value svg { width: 0.24rem; height: 0.24rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.perf-value__mobile { display: none; }

/* ── Expandable text wrapper ── */
.expandable-text {
    margin-top: 0.16rem;

    &.with-margin-bottom {
        margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    }
}
.expandable-text .listing-desc,
.expandable-text .company-field__value {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
.company-field .expandable-text {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* ── Truncated description with See more ── */
.listing-desc--truncated {
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    white-space: normal;
}
.see-more-link {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.04rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #1b1625;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin-top: 0.08rem;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 0.02rem;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0;
    font-family: inherit;
}
.see-more-link svg {
    transition: transform 0.2s ease;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}
.see-more-link.expanded svg {
    transform: rotate(180deg);
}

/* ── Price reduced badge ── */
.price-reduced-badge {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.06rem;
    padding: 0.06rem 0.12rem;
    border-radius: 0.04rem;
    border: 1px solid #3E50F7;
    background: #EEF2FE;           
    font-size: 0.1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #3E50F7;
    white-space: nowrap;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

/* ── Category icon card container ── */
.type-card__icon {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-width: 0.44rem;
    width: 0.44rem;
    height: 0.44rem;
    border-radius: 0.1rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    background: #fff;
}
.type-card__icon svg {
    width: 0.24rem;
    height: 0.24rem;
}

/* ── Annual snapshot table ── */
.annual-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
.annual-table th { font-size: 0.11rem; font-weight: 600; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: left; padding: 0.12rem 0.16rem; border-bottom: 0.02rem solid #f0f0f5; }
.annual-table td { font-size: 0.14rem; padding: 0.14rem 0.16rem; border-bottom: 0.01rem solid #f0f0f5; color: #25224a; }
.annual-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }

/* ── Blurred section (chart placeholder with lock) ── */
.blurred-section {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f0eef7, #e8e6f0);
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}
.blurred-section--chart {
    min-height: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.blurred-section--sidebar {
    min-height: 0.08rem;
}
.blurred-section::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(
        0deg,
        transparent,
        transparent 0.3rem,
        rgba(62, 80, 247, 0.03) 0.3rem,
        rgba(62, 80, 247, 0.03) 0.31rem
    );
    pointer-events: none;
}
.blurred-section svg {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* ── Metrics top row (customer metrics visible values) ── */
.metrics-top-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 0.2rem 0.3rem;
}
.metrics-top-item {
    position: relative;
    margin: 0 0 0.2rem;
    border-right: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
}
.metrics-top-item .listing-label {
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n),
.metrics-top-item:last-child {
    border-right: none;
}
/* Last row: no bottom margin (margin only separates rows). */
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):nth-last-child(-n + 4),
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):nth-last-child(-n + 4) ~ .metrics-top-item {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
/* Spacing below the grid only when the locked-chart blur follows it. */
.metrics-top-row + .section__blur {
    margin-top: 0.2rem;
}
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):not(:first-child)::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: -0.2rem;
    left: 0;
    width: calc(4 * 100% + 3 * 0.3rem);
    border-top: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
}
.metrics-top-value {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.08rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    color: #25224a;
}
.metrics-top-value svg { width: 0.24rem; height: 0.24rem; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* ── Bullet list ── */
.bullet-list {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.08rem;
}
.bullet-list li {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.1rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    color: #25224a;
    line-height: 1.5;
}
.bullet-list li::before {
    content: "";
    display: inline-block;
    width: 0.06rem;
    height: 0.06rem;
    min-width: 0.06rem;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #3e50f7;
    margin-top: 0.07rem;
}

/* ── Company field ── */
.companiey-fields-row { 
    display: flex; 
    flex-direction: row; 
    gap: 0.7rem; 
}
.company-field {
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;

    &.no-margin-bottom {
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }
}
.company-field__value {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    color: #25224a;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
}
.company-field__value--truncated {
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 4;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* ── Highlight cards ── */
.highlight-cards {
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    padding: 0.4rem;
}
.highlight-card {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.16rem;
    align-items: flex-start;
    margin-bottom: 0.28rem;
    &:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
}
.highlight-card__text { flex: 1; }
.highlight-card__title {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #25224a;
    margin-bottom: 0.04rem;
}
.highlight-card__desc {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: #464154;
}

/* ── Right sidebar ── */
.private-info-block {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    padding: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.sidebar-section { 
    margin-bottom: 0.32rem;
    &:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
}
.sidebar-section__title { font-size: 0.18rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; }
.sidebar-section__blur {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 0 -0.2rem;
}
.sidebar-section__blur img {
    width: 100%;
    display: block;
}
.sidebar-section__lock {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 2;
    color: #3e50f7;
    font-size: 0.24rem;
}
.sidebar-section__lock svg { width: 0.3rem; height: 0.3rem; }

/* ── Bottom banner ── */
.bottom-banner {
    background: radial-gradient(155.37% 120.73% at 94.83% 5.59%, #2f2b6d 55.35%, #1e1b3b);
    border-radius: 0.2rem;
    padding: 0.7rem 2.78rem;
    text-align: center;
    color: #fff;
    margin-top: 0.24rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
}
.bottom-banner__title { font-size: 0.32rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 0.1rem; line-height: 120%; }
.bottom-banner__desc { font-size: 0.14rem; font-weight: 400; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 0.24rem; }
.bottom-banner__features {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0;
    margin-top: 0.32rem;
    background: #3c377f;
    border: 1px solid #4b45a0;
    border-radius: 0.1rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    width: 100%;
}
.bottom-banner__feature {
    flex: 1;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 0.24rem 0.2rem;
}
.bottom-banner__feature-icon { display: flex; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; justify-content: center; }
.bottom-banner__feature-title {
    font-size: 0.1rem;
    line-height: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #9995C1;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    margin-bottom: 0.06rem;
}
.bottom-banner__feature-text { font-size: 0.12rem; color: #fff; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 700; }
.bottom-banner__feature-divider { display: none; }

/* ── Footer ── */
.footer {
    margin-top: auto;
}
.footer-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding-top: 0.32rem;
    padding-bottom: 0.27rem;
    border-top: 1px dotted rgba(42, 31, 65, 0.2);
    max-width: 15.6rem;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding-left: 0.72rem;
    padding-right: 0.72rem;
}
.footer-copy {
    font-size: 0.12rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: #6b7280;
}
.footer-contact {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding-right: 0.4rem;
}
.footer-contact .footer-link {
    color: #3e50f7;
    text-decoration: none;
}
.footer-contact .footer-link:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
}
.footer .mb-16 {
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}

/* ── Mini modal ── */
.mini-modal-trigger {
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-decoration-style: dotted;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
    text-decoration-color: #9ca3af;
}
.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; }
.mini-modal {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.2rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 4px 6px 14px 0 rgba(42, 31, 65, 0.16);
    z-index: 100;
    width: 3.2rem;
    max-width: 3.2rem;
}
.mini-modal--open { display: block; }
.mini-modal__title {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #25224a;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
    white-space: normal;
    text-transform: none;
}
.mini-modal__text {
    font-weight: 400;
    font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-transform: none;
    white-space: break-spaces;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0.1rem;
    right: 0.1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0.04rem;
    line-height: 1;
    font-size: 0.16rem;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close:hover { color: #25224a; }
.mini-modal__link {
    display: inline;
    color: #3e50f7;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: 500;
}
.mini-modal__link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.mini-modal-bg {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    z-index: 99;
}
.mini-modal-bg--open { display: block; }
/* Hero labels — white text needs white dotted underline */
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger { text-decoration-color: rgba(164, 161, 203, 0.5); }
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger:hover,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: #a4a1cb; }
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger .mini-modal,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger .mini-modal { white-space: normal; }

/* ── Shake animation ── */
.shaker {
    animation: shake 1s cubic-bezier(0.36, 0.07, 0.19, 0.97) both;
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    backface-visibility: hidden;
    perspective: 1000px;
}
@keyframes shake {
    10%, 90% { transform: translate3d(-1px, 0, 0); }
    20%, 80% { transform: translate3d(2px, 0, 0); }
    30%, 50%, 70% { transform: translate3d(-4px, 0, 0); }
    40%, 60% { transform: translate3d(4px, 0, 0); }
}
.section__blur, .sidebar-section__blur { cursor: pointer; }

/* ── Mobile CTA bar ── */
.mobile-cta-bar { display: none; }

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .header { height: 0.64rem; padding: 0.16rem 0.4rem; }
    body { padding-top: 0.64rem; }
    .header__logo { height: 0.26rem; }
    .header__free-saas { display: none; }
    .mobile-cta-bar {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row;

        display: inline-flex;

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    body { background: #fff; padding-top: 0.64rem; }
    .header { height: auto; padding: 0.22rem 0.2rem; }
    .nav-menu-btn:hover { box-shadow: none; }
    .mobile-cta-bar { padding: 0.2rem 0.2rem 0.18rem; }
    .hero {
        width: 100%;
        padding: .2rem;
        margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .hero__top { margin-bottom: 0.24rem; }
    .hero__category { flex-direction: column; gap: 0.06rem; }
    .hero__category-text { font-size: 0.11rem; line-height: 0.16rem; }

                    <h1 class="listing-headline">Shopify DTC Hemp-Derived Wellness Brand — $47K TTM Profit, 1,300% YoY Growth</h1>
                    <div class="expandable-text with-margin-bottom">
        <div class="listing-desc listing-desc--truncated" id="desc-main">This fast-growing DTC hemp-derived wellness brand sells premium, federally compliant gummies and cannabinoid products to customers nationwide. Built on Shopify with lean, automated ops, it produced $63.6K TTM revenue and $47.25K TTM profit with 13x+ YoY growth—delivering relaxation, balance, and everyday wellness without heavy overhead.

The asset includes proven suppliers, polished branding, and a loyal, expanding customer base from 526 orders. With clear paths to scale via wholesale, retail partnerships, and new product development, a new owner can step in and accelerate quickly.

Key Highlights
✅ ~74% TTM margin; last month $9.8K revenue, $7.0K profit
✅ Turnkey Shopify DTC; solo-run, low overhead
✅ Federally compliant; ships nationwide
✅ 526 orders; 251–500 customers and growing
✅ Scale via SEO, content, sales hire, and pricing
✅ Expand to B2B wholesale, retail, and new SKUs
✅ Priced at $99,060 for a scalable, high-margin brand</div>

var activeMiniModal = null;
var miniModalBg = null;
function openMiniModal(trigger) {
    closeMiniModal();
    var modal = trigger.querySelector('.mini-modal');
    if (!modal) return;
    if (window.innerWidth > 1024) {
        var rect = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
        modal.style.top = (rect.bottom + 8) + 'px';
        modal.style.left = rect.left + 'px';
    } else {
        modal.style.top = '';
        modal.style.left = '';
    }
    modal.classList.add('mini-modal--open');
    activeMiniModal = modal;
    if (!miniModalBg) {
        miniModalBg = document.createElement('div');
        miniModalBg.className = 'mini-modal-bg';
        miniModalBg.addEventListener('click', function () { closeMiniModal(); });
        document.body.appendChild(miniModalBg);
    }
    miniModalBg.classList.add('mini-modal-bg--open');
}
function closeMiniModal(e) {
    if (e) { e.stopPropagation(); }
    if (activeMiniModal) {
        activeMiniModal.classList.remove('mini-modal--open');
        activeMiniModal = null;
    }
    if (miniModalBg) { miniModalBg.classList.remove('mini-modal-bg--open'); }

function scrollToCtaAndShake() {
    var cta = document.querySelector('.cta-card');
    if (!cta) return;
    var rect = cta.getBoundingClientRect();
    var scrollTop = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
    window.scrollTo({ top: rect.top + scrollTop - 100, behavior: 'smooth' });
    setTimeout(function () {
        cta.classList.add('shaker');
        setTimeout(function () { cta.classList.remove('shaker'); }, 1000);
    }, 400);
}

        el.addEventListener('click', scrollToCtaAndShake);

                openMiniModal(trigger);
            }
        });
    });
});

.listing-value { font-size: 0.18rem; line-height: 0.24rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; }
.listing-value__underlined { border-bottom: 1px dotted #7F798D; }

.price-row { display: flex; gap: 0.7rem; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }

/* ── Performance ── */
.perf-grid { display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 0.7rem; }
.perf-item { text-align: left; }
.perf-label { width: fit-content; display: block; font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 600; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-bottom: 0.08rem; }
.perf-value { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.06rem; font-size: 0.14rem; line-height: 0.25rem; font-weight: 500; color: #25224a; }
.perf-value svg { width: 0.24rem; height: 0.24rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.perf-value__mobile { display: none; }

/* ── Expandable text wrapper ── */
.expandable-text {
    margin-top: 0.16rem;

    &.with-margin-bottom {
        margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    }
}
.expandable-text .listing-desc,
.expandable-text .company-field__value {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
.company-field .expandable-text {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* ── Truncated description with See more ── */
.listing-desc--truncated {
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    white-space: normal;
}
.see-more-link {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.04rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #1b1625;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin-top: 0.08rem;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 0.02rem;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0;
    font-family: inherit;
}
.see-more-link svg {
    transition: transform 0.2s ease;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}
.see-more-link.expanded svg {
    transform: rotate(180deg);
}

/* ── Price reduced badge ── */
.price-reduced-badge {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.06rem;
    padding: 0.06rem 0.12rem;
    border-radius: 0.04rem;
    border: 1px solid #3E50F7;
    background: #EEF2FE;           
    font-size: 0.1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #3E50F7;
    white-space: nowrap;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

/* ── Category icon card container ── */
.type-card__icon {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-width: 0.44rem;
    width: 0.44rem;
    height: 0.44rem;
    border-radius: 0.1rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    background: #fff;
}
.type-card__icon svg {
    width: 0.24rem;
    height: 0.24rem;
}

/* ── Annual snapshot table ── */
.annual-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
.annual-table th { font-size: 0.11rem; font-weight: 600; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: left; padding: 0.12rem 0.16rem; border-bottom: 0.02rem solid #f0f0f5; }
.annual-table td { font-size: 0.14rem; padding: 0.14rem 0.16rem; border-bottom: 0.01rem solid #f0f0f5; color: #25224a; }
.annual-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }

/* ── Blurred section (chart placeholder with lock) ── */
.blurred-section {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f0eef7, #e8e6f0);
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}
.blurred-section--chart {
    min-height: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.blurred-section--sidebar {
    min-height: 0.08rem;
}
.blurred-section::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(
        0deg,
        transparent,
        transparent 0.3rem,
        rgba(62, 80, 247, 0.03) 0.3rem,
        rgba(62, 80, 247, 0.03) 0.31rem
    );
    pointer-events: none;
}
.blurred-section svg {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* ── Metrics top row (customer metrics visible values) ── */
.metrics-top-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 0.2rem 0.3rem;
}
.metrics-top-item {
    position: relative;
    margin: 0 0 0.2rem;
    border-right: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
}
.metrics-top-item .listing-label {
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n),
.metrics-top-item:last-child {
    border-right: none;
}
/* Last row: no bottom margin (margin only separates rows). */
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):nth-last-child(-n + 4),
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):nth-last-child(-n + 4) ~ .metrics-top-item {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
/* Spacing below the grid only when the locked-chart blur follows it. */
.metrics-top-row + .section__blur {
    margin-top: 0.2rem;
}
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):not(:first-child)::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: -0.2rem;
    left: 0;
    width: calc(4 * 100% + 3 * 0.3rem);
    border-top: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
}
.metrics-top-value {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.08rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    color: #25224a;
}
.metrics-top-value svg { width: 0.24rem; height: 0.24rem; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* ── Bullet list ── */
.bullet-list {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.08rem;
}
.bullet-list li {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.1rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    color: #25224a;
    line-height: 1.5;
}
.bullet-list li::before {
    content: "";
    display: inline-block;
    width: 0.06rem;
    height: 0.06rem;
    min-width: 0.06rem;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #3e50f7;
    margin-top: 0.07rem;
}

/* ── Company field ── */
.companiey-fields-row { 
    display: flex; 
    flex-direction: row; 
    gap: 0.7rem; 
}
.company-field {
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;

    &.no-margin-bottom {
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }
}
.company-field__value {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    color: #25224a;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
}
.company-field__value--truncated {
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 4;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* ── Highlight cards ── */
.highlight-cards {
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    padding: 0.4rem;
}
.highlight-card {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.16rem;
    align-items: flex-start;
    margin-bottom: 0.28rem;
    &:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
}
.highlight-card__text { flex: 1; }
.highlight-card__title {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #25224a;
    margin-bottom: 0.04rem;
}
.highlight-card__desc {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: #464154;
}

/* ── Right sidebar ── */
.private-info-block {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    padding: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.sidebar-section { 
    margin-bottom: 0.32rem;
    &:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
}
.sidebar-section__title { font-size: 0.18rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; }
.sidebar-section__blur {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 0 -0.2rem;
}
.sidebar-section__blur img {
    width: 100%;
    display: block;
}
.sidebar-section__lock {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 2;
    color: #3e50f7;
    font-size: 0.24rem;
}
.sidebar-section__lock svg { width: 0.3rem; height: 0.3rem; }

/* ── Bottom banner ── */
.bottom-banner {
    background: radial-gradient(155.37% 120.73% at 94.83% 5.59%, #2f2b6d 55.35%, #1e1b3b);
    border-radius: 0.2rem;
    padding: 0.7rem 2.78rem;
    text-align: center;
    color: #fff;
    margin-top: 0.24rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
}
.bottom-banner__title { font-size: 0.32rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 0.1rem; line-height: 120%; }
.bottom-banner__desc { font-size: 0.14rem; font-weight: 400; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 0.24rem; }
.bottom-banner__features {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0;
    margin-top: 0.32rem;
    background: #3c377f;
    border: 1px solid #4b45a0;
    border-radius: 0.1rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    width: 100%;
}
.bottom-banner__feature {
    flex: 1;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 0.24rem 0.2rem;
}
.bottom-banner__feature-icon { display: flex; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; justify-content: center; }
.bottom-banner__feature-title {
    font-size: 0.1rem;
    line-height: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #9995C1;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    margin-bottom: 0.06rem;
}
.bottom-banner__feature-text { font-size: 0.12rem; color: #fff; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 700; }
.bottom-banner__feature-divider { display: none; }

/* ── Footer ── */
.footer {
    margin-top: auto;
}
.footer-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding-top: 0.32rem;
    padding-bottom: 0.27rem;
    border-top: 1px dotted rgba(42, 31, 65, 0.2);
    max-width: 15.6rem;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding-left: 0.72rem;
    padding-right: 0.72rem;
}
.footer-copy {
    font-size: 0.12rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: #6b7280;
}
.footer-contact {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding-right: 0.4rem;
}
.footer-contact .footer-link {
    color: #3e50f7;
    text-decoration: none;
}
.footer-contact .footer-link:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
}
.footer .mb-16 {
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}

/* ── Mini modal ── */
.mini-modal-trigger {
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-decoration-style: dotted;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
    text-decoration-color: #9ca3af;
}
.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; }
.mini-modal {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.2rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 4px 6px 14px 0 rgba(42, 31, 65, 0.16);
    z-index: 100;
    width: 3.2rem;
    max-width: 3.2rem;
}
.mini-modal--open { display: block; }
.mini-modal__title {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #25224a;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
    white-space: normal;
    text-transform: none;
}
.mini-modal__text {
    font-weight: 400;
    font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-transform: none;
    white-space: break-spaces;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0.1rem;
    right: 0.1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0.04rem;
    line-height: 1;
    font-size: 0.16rem;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close:hover { color: #25224a; }
.mini-modal__link {
    display: inline;
    color: #3e50f7;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: 500;
}
.mini-modal__link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.mini-modal-bg {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    z-index: 99;
}
.mini-modal-bg--open { display: block; }
/* Hero labels — white text needs white dotted underline */
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger { text-decoration-color: rgba(164, 161, 203, 0.5); }
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger:hover,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: #a4a1cb; }
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger .mini-modal,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger .mini-modal { white-space: normal; }

/* ── Shake animation ── */
.shaker {
    animation: shake 1s cubic-bezier(0.36, 0.07, 0.19, 0.97) both;
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    backface-visibility: hidden;
    perspective: 1000px;
}
@keyframes shake {
    10%, 90% { transform: translate3d(-1px, 0, 0); }
    20%, 80% { transform: translate3d(2px, 0, 0); }
    30%, 50%, 70% { transform: translate3d(-4px, 0, 0); }
    40%, 60% { transform: translate3d(4px, 0, 0); }
}
.section__blur, .sidebar-section__blur { cursor: pointer; }

/* ── Mobile CTA bar ── */
.mobile-cta-bar { display: none; }

                    <h1 class="listing-headline">Developer-first platform for freelancers to manage client business and streamline tasks</h1>
                    <div class="expandable-text with-margin-bottom">
        <div class="listing-desc listing-desc--truncated" id="desc-main">A developer-first business management platform designed to help freelance developers streamline client work and manage day-to-day operations from a single workspace. The platform combines contracts, invoicing, GitHub integration, time tracking, expense management, and project administration into one solution tailored to developer workflows. It also includes a business API and credential vault to support secure operations, enabling freelancers to spend less time on administrative tasks and more time building products.

Key Highlights
✅ Business management platform built for freelance developers
✅ Combines contracts, invoicing, time tracking, and expense management
✅ Integrates with GitHub to support developer workflows
✅ Includes a business API and secure credential vault
✅ Helps manage client projects, scope changes, and administrative tasks
✅ Enables freelancers to operate more efficiently and focus on product delivery</div>

        modal.style.top = (rect.bottom + 8) + 'px';
        modal.style.left = rect.left + 'px';
    } else {

        miniModalBg.addEventListener('click', function () { closeMiniModal(); });
        document.body.appendChild(miniModalBg);
    }

}

}

.nav-menu-dropdown--open { display: block; }
.nav-menu-dropdown__section {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: 0.1rem 0 0.12rem;
}
.nav-menu-dropdown__section:first-child { border-bottom: 1px solid #a8a7b7; }
.nav-menu-dropdown__item {
    display: block;
    padding: 0.08rem 0.23rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    color: #6b7280;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: background 0.3s;
}
.nav-menu-dropdown__item--primary { color: #25224a; font-weight: 500; }
.nav-menu-dropdown__item:hover { background: #f5f4f8; }

/* ── Container ── */
.container { max-width: 15.6rem; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0.24rem 0.72rem 0.72rem; }

/* ── Hero ── */
.hero {
    background: linear-gradient(45deg, #1e1b3b 40%, #2f2b6d 60%);
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    padding: 0.4rem;
    color: #fff;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}
.hero__top { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; }
.hero__category { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.08rem; }
.hero__category-text { font-size: 0.12rem; color: #a4a1cb; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.3px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.04rem; }
.hero__category-text svg { width: 0.18rem; height: 0.18rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.hero__category-text a { color: #a4a1cb; text-decoration: underline; }
.hero__location { font-size: 0.12rem; line-height: 0.18rem; color: #a4a1cb; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.3px; margin-left: 0.16rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.04rem; }
.hero__location svg { width: 0.18rem; height: 0.18rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.hero__name-blocker {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.1rem;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #3c377f 10%, #6b63e5 70%, #3c377f 100%);
    border: 1px solid #4b45a0;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    padding: 0.12rem 0.52rem;
    margin: 0.16rem auto;
}
.hero__name-blocker svg { width: 0.16rem; height: 0.16rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.hero__name-blocker span { font-size: 0.14rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 0.24rem; color: #fff; }
.hero__headline {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.24rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: #a4a1cb;
    text-align: center;
    max-width: 5.72rem;
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
}
.hero__badges { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 0.04rem; margin-top: 0.16rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.badge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.04rem;
    background: #27245b;
    border: 1px solid #4b45a0;
    padding: .08rem .12rem;
    border-radius: .9rem;       
    font-size: 0.12rem;
    line-height: 0.18rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #fff;
}
.badge svg { width: 0.16rem; height: 0.16rem; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* ── Hero bottom: metrics + CTA ── */
.hero__bottom { display: flex; gap: 0.4rem; margin-top: 0.32rem; }

/* ── Metrics column ── */
.metrics-col { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.metrics-card {
    background: #3c377f;
    border-radius: 0.1rem;
    border: 1px solid #4b45a0;
    padding: 0.3rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.1rem;
}
.metrics-card:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.metrics-card__row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; }
.metrics-card__divider { width: 1px; align-self: stretch; background: #4b45a0; margin: 0 0.2rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.metrics-card__label { font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 700; color: #a4a1cb; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-bottom: 0.08rem; white-space: nowrap; }
.metrics-card__value { font-size: 0.18rem; line-height: 0.24rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; white-space: nowrap; }

/* Revenue bars */
.rev-row { margin-bottom: 0.38rem; }
.rev-row:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.rev-header { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; margin-bottom: 0.12rem; }
.rev-header__col { width: 1.4rem; margin-right: 0.25rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.rev-header__label { font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; color: #a4a1cb; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-bottom: 0.06rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.06rem; }
.rev-header__label::before { content: ""; display: inline-block; width: 0.08rem; height: 0.08rem; border-radius: 0.02rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.rev-header__label--revenue::before { background: #5650AC; }
.rev-header__label--profit-ttm::before { background: #7EDC72; }
.rev-header__label--profit-lm::before { background: #72BCDC; }
.rev-header__value { font-size: 0.2rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; line-height: 1.2; white-space: nowrap; }
.rev-bar {
    height: 0.1rem;
    border-radius: 0.22rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    background:
        repeating-linear-gradient(
            135deg,
            #5650AC 0 .28rem,
            #4B4696 0 .33rem
        ) 0 / 100%;
}
.rev-bar__fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 0.22rem; }

/* ── CTA column (hero) ── */
.cta-col { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.cta-card {
    border: 1px dashed #6b66b6;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    background: linear-gradient(45deg, #2F2B6D 60%, #1E1B3B 100%);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;
    height: 100%;
    padding: 0 1.06rem;
    width: 5.88rem;
    height: 3.42rem;
}
.cta-card__icon { display: flex; height: 0.3rem; margin-bottom: 0.26rem; }
.cta-card__title { font-size: 0.18rem; line-height: 0.24rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 11px; }
.cta-card__desc { font-size: 0.16rem; color: #a4a1cb; margin-bottom: 0.28rem; line-height: 0.24rem; }
.cta-card__btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    width: 2.54rem;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.08rem;
    padding: 0.16rem 0.26rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 0 0.09rem 0.09rem;
    font-size: 0.13rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #000;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: opacity 0.2s;
}
.cta-card__btn:hover { opacity: 0.85; text-decoration: none; }

/* ── Content area ── */
.content { display: flex; gap: 0.16rem; }
.content__left { 
    padding: 0.1rem; 
    flex: 5; 
    min-width: 0; 
    background: #fff; 
    border-radius: 0.09rem; 
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    max-width: 8rem;
}
.content__right { width: 4.76rem; }

/* ── Sections ── */
.section {
    padding: 0 0.3rem 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
.section__header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.09rem;
    padding: 0.2rem 0;
    margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
    border-bottom: 0.02rem solid #f0f0f5;
    background: #f5f7ff;
    border-radius: 0.06rem;
    padding: 0.3rem;
    margin: 0 -0.3rem 0.4rem;
    border-bottom: none;
}
.section__title { font-size: 0.16rem; line-height: 0.21rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; }
.section__updated { font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 500; color: #7f798d; margin-left: auto; }
.section__provider-logo { height: 0.26rem; width: auto; margin-left: 0.06rem; }
.section__category-badge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.06rem;
    font-size: 0.16rem;
    font-weight: 700;
}
.section__location { font-size: 0.14rem; color: #7f798d; margin-left: 0.12rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.04rem; }
.section__location svg { width: 0.14rem; height: 0.14rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.section__location svg path { fill: #7f798d; }
.section__blur {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 0 -0.32rem;
}
.section__blur img {
    width: 100%;
    display: block;
}

.listing-headline { font-size: 0.16rem; font-weight: 500; color: #25224a; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; line-height: 1.4; }
.listing-desc { font-size: 0.14rem; color: #464154; line-height: 0.22rem; white-space: pre-line; margin-bottom: 0.24rem; }
.listing-label { font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 700; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-bottom: 0.08rem; }
.listing-label__double-margin { margin-bottom: 0.16rem; }
.listing-value { font-size: 0.18rem; line-height: 0.24rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; }
.listing-value__underlined { border-bottom: 1px dotted #7F798D; }

.price-row { display: flex; gap: 0.7rem; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }

/* ── Performance ── */
.perf-grid { display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 0.7rem; }
.perf-item { text-align: left; }
.perf-label { width: fit-content; display: block; font-size: 0.1rem; line-height: 0.14rem; font-weight: 600; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-bottom: 0.08rem; }
.perf-value { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.06rem; font-size: 0.14rem; line-height: 0.25rem; font-weight: 500; color: #25224a; }
.perf-value svg { width: 0.24rem; height: 0.24rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.perf-value__mobile { display: none; }

/* ── Expandable text wrapper ── */
.expandable-text {
    margin-top: 0.16rem;

    &.with-margin-bottom {
        margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    }
}
.expandable-text .listing-desc,
.expandable-text .company-field__value {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
.company-field .expandable-text {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* ── Truncated description with See more ── */
.listing-desc--truncated {
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    white-space: normal;
}
.see-more-link {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.04rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #1b1625;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin-top: 0.08rem;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 0.02rem;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0;
    font-family: inherit;
}
.see-more-link svg {
    transition: transform 0.2s ease;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}
.see-more-link.expanded svg {
    transform: rotate(180deg);
}

/* ── Price reduced badge ── */
.price-reduced-badge {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.06rem;
    padding: 0.06rem 0.12rem;
    border-radius: 0.04rem;
    border: 1px solid #3E50F7;
    background: #EEF2FE;           
    font-size: 0.1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #3E50F7;
    white-space: nowrap;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

/* ── Category icon card container ── */
.type-card__icon {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-width: 0.44rem;
    width: 0.44rem;
    height: 0.44rem;
    border-radius: 0.1rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    background: #fff;
}
.type-card__icon svg {
    width: 0.24rem;
    height: 0.24rem;
}

/* ── Annual snapshot table ── */
.annual-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
.annual-table th { font-size: 0.11rem; font-weight: 600; color: #3e50f7; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: left; padding: 0.12rem 0.16rem; border-bottom: 0.02rem solid #f0f0f5; }
.annual-table td { font-size: 0.14rem; padding: 0.14rem 0.16rem; border-bottom: 0.01rem solid #f0f0f5; color: #25224a; }
.annual-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }

/* ── Blurred section (chart placeholder with lock) ── */
.blurred-section {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f0eef7, #e8e6f0);
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}
.blurred-section--chart {
    min-height: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.blurred-section--sidebar {
    min-height: 0.08rem;
}
.blurred-section::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(
        0deg,
        transparent,
        transparent 0.3rem,
        rgba(62, 80, 247, 0.03) 0.3rem,
        rgba(62, 80, 247, 0.03) 0.31rem
    );
    pointer-events: none;
}
.blurred-section svg {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* ── Metrics top row (customer metrics visible values) ── */
.metrics-top-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 0.2rem 0.3rem;
}
.metrics-top-item {
    position: relative;
    margin: 0 0 0.2rem;
    border-right: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
}
.metrics-top-item .listing-label {
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n),
.metrics-top-item:last-child {
    border-right: none;
}
/* Last row: no bottom margin (margin only separates rows). */
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):nth-last-child(-n + 4),
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):nth-last-child(-n + 4) ~ .metrics-top-item {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
/* Spacing below the grid only when the locked-chart blur follows it. */
.metrics-top-row + .section__blur {
    margin-top: 0.2rem;
}
.metrics-top-item:nth-child(4n + 1):not(:first-child)::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: -0.2rem;
    left: 0;
    width: calc(4 * 100% + 3 * 0.3rem);
    border-top: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
}
.metrics-top-value {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.08rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    color: #25224a;
}
.metrics-top-value svg { width: 0.24rem; height: 0.24rem; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* ── Bullet list ── */
.bullet-list {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.08rem;
}
.bullet-list li {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.1rem;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    color: #25224a;
    line-height: 1.5;
}
.bullet-list li::before {
    content: "";
    display: inline-block;
    width: 0.06rem;
    height: 0.06rem;
    min-width: 0.06rem;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #3e50f7;
    margin-top: 0.07rem;
}

/* ── Company field ── */
.companiey-fields-row { 
    display: flex; 
    flex-direction: row; 
    gap: 0.7rem; 
}
.company-field {
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;

    &.no-margin-bottom {
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }
}
.company-field__value {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    color: #25224a;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
}
.company-field__value--truncated {
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 4;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* ── Highlight cards ── */
.highlight-cards {
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    padding: 0.4rem;
}
.highlight-card {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.16rem;
    align-items: flex-start;
    margin-bottom: 0.28rem;
    &:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
}
.highlight-card__text { flex: 1; }
.highlight-card__title {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #25224a;
    margin-bottom: 0.04rem;
}
.highlight-card__desc {
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: #464154;
}

/* ── Right sidebar ── */
.private-info-block {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    border-radius: 0.09rem;
    padding: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}
.sidebar-section { 
    margin-bottom: 0.32rem;
    &:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
}
.sidebar-section__title { font-size: 0.18rem; font-weight: 700; color: #25224a; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; }
.sidebar-section__blur {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 0 -0.2rem;
}
.sidebar-section__blur img {
    width: 100%;
    display: block;
}
.sidebar-section__lock {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 2;
    color: #3e50f7;
    font-size: 0.24rem;
}
.sidebar-section__lock svg { width: 0.3rem; height: 0.3rem; }

/* ── Bottom banner ── */
.bottom-banner {
    background: radial-gradient(155.37% 120.73% at 94.83% 5.59%, #2f2b6d 55.35%, #1e1b3b);
    border-radius: 0.2rem;
    padding: 0.7rem 2.78rem;
    text-align: center;
    color: #fff;
    margin-top: 0.24rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
}
.bottom-banner__title { font-size: 0.32rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 0.1rem; line-height: 120%; }
.bottom-banner__desc { font-size: 0.14rem; font-weight: 400; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 0.24rem; }
.bottom-banner__features {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0;
    margin-top: 0.32rem;
    background: #3c377f;
    border: 1px solid #4b45a0;
    border-radius: 0.1rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    width: 100%;
}
.bottom-banner__feature {
    flex: 1;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 0.24rem 0.2rem;
}
.bottom-banner__feature-icon { display: flex; margin-bottom: 0.16rem; justify-content: center; }
.bottom-banner__feature-title {
    font-size: 0.1rem;
    line-height: 0.14rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #9995C1;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    margin-bottom: 0.06rem;
}
.bottom-banner__feature-text { font-size: 0.12rem; color: #fff; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 700; }
.bottom-banner__feature-divider { display: none; }

/* ── Footer ── */
.footer {
    margin-top: auto;
}
.footer-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding-top: 0.32rem;
    padding-bottom: 0.27rem;
    border-top: 1px dotted rgba(42, 31, 65, 0.2);
    max-width: 15.6rem;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding-left: 0.72rem;
    padding-right: 0.72rem;
}
.footer-copy {
    font-size: 0.12rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: #6b7280;
}
.footer-contact {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding-right: 0.4rem;
}
.footer-contact .footer-link {
    color: #3e50f7;
    text-decoration: none;
}
.footer-contact .footer-link:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
}
.footer .mb-16 {
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
}

/* ── Mini modal ── */
.mini-modal-trigger {
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-decoration-style: dotted;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
    text-decoration-color: #9ca3af;
}
.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; }
.mini-modal {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.2rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px dotted #bfbcc6;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 4px 6px 14px 0 rgba(42, 31, 65, 0.16);
    z-index: 100;
    width: 3.2rem;
    max-width: 3.2rem;
}
.mini-modal--open { display: block; }
.mini-modal__title {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #25224a;
    margin-bottom: 0.16rem;
    white-space: normal;
    text-transform: none;
}
.mini-modal__text {
    font-weight: 400;
    font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-transform: none;
    white-space: break-spaces;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0.1rem;
    right: 0.1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0.04rem;
    line-height: 1;
    font-size: 0.16rem;
    color: #7F798D;
}
.mini-modal__close:hover { color: #25224a; }
.mini-modal__link {
    display: inline;
    color: #3e50f7;
    font-size: 0.14rem;
    line-height: 0.22rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: 500;
}
.mini-modal__link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.mini-modal-bg {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    z-index: 99;
}
.mini-modal-bg--open { display: block; }
/* Hero labels — white text needs white dotted underline */
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger { text-decoration-color: rgba(164, 161, 203, 0.5); }
.metrics-card__label.mini-modal-trigger:hover,
.rev-header__label.mini-modal-trigger:hover { text-decoration-color: #a4a1cb; }

/* ── Shake animation ── */
.shaker {
    animation: shake 1s cubic-bezier(0.36, 0.07, 0.19, 0.97) both;
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    backface-visibility: hidden;
    perspective: 1000px;
}
@keyframes shake {
    10%, 90% { transform: translate3d(-1px, 0, 0); }
    20%, 80% { transform: translate3d(2px, 0, 0); }
    30%, 50%, 70% { transform: translate3d(-4px, 0, 0); }
    40%, 60% { transform: translate3d(4px, 0, 0); }

        <div class="listing-desc listing-desc--truncated" id="desc-reasoning">In determining our asking price for the fintech start-up, we have carefully considered industry standards, specifically the multiples commonly applied to the Gross Loan Value (GLV) of P2P lending businesses in Indonesia. Industry-standard multiples often hover around 0.75 times the Gross Loan Value. However, recognizing the unique strengths and potential growth trajectory of our company, we propose a conservative valuation at 0.1 times the Gross Loan Value.

It's crucial to note that in 2024, our Gross Loan Value is reach $18 million. This valuation not only reflects our commitment to sound financial principles but also takes into account the remarkable growth and revenue potential we anticipate for the upcoming year.

We firmly believe that this valuation is justified by the current and projected performance of our fintech start-up. We welcome any further discussions or inquiries you may have and look forward to the opportunity to provide more insights into our valuation.</div>

    var dd = document.getElementById('nav-menu-dropdown');
    dd.classList.toggle('nav-menu-dropdown--open');
}
document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var wrapper = document.querySelector('.nav-menu-wrapper');
    var dd = document.getElementById('nav-menu-dropdown');
    if (wrapper && dd && !wrapper.contains(e.target)) {
        dd.classList.remove('nav-menu-dropdown--open');
    }
});
function toggleDesc(id, btn) {
    var desc = document.getElementById(id);
    var expanded = btn.classList.contains('expanded');
    var textNode = btn.firstChild;
    if (expanded) {
        desc.classList.add('listing-desc--truncated');
        btn.classList.remove('expanded');
        textNode.textContent = 'See more ';
    } else {
        desc.classList.remove('listing-desc--truncated');
        btn.classList.add('expanded');
        textNode.textContent = 'See less ';
    }
}
var activeMiniModal = null;
var miniModalBg = null;
function openMiniModal(trigger) {
    closeMiniModal();
    var modal = trigger.querySelector('.mini-modal');
    if (!modal) return;
    if (window.innerWidth > 1024) {
        var rect = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
        modal.style.top = (rect.bottom + 8) + 'px';
        modal.style.left = rect.left + 'px';
    } else {
        modal.style.top = '';
        modal.style.left = '';
    }
    modal.classList.add('mini-modal--open');
    activeMiniModal = modal;
    if (!miniModalBg) {
        miniModalBg = document.createElement('div');
        miniModalBg.className = 'mini-modal-bg';
        miniModalBg.addEventListener('click', function () { closeMiniModal(); });
        document.body.appendChild(miniModalBg);
    }
    miniModalBg.classList.add('mini-modal-bg--open');
}
function closeMiniModal(e) {
    if (e) { e.stopPropagation(); }
    if (activeMiniModal) {
        activeMiniModal.classList.remove('mini-modal--open');
        activeMiniModal = null;
    }
    if (miniModalBg) { miniModalBg.classList.remove('mini-modal-bg--open'); }
}
function scrollToCtaAndShake() {
    var cta = document.querySelector('.cta-card');
    if (!cta) return;
    var rect = cta.getBoundingClientRect();
    var scrollTop = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
    window.scrollTo({ top: rect.top + scrollTop - 100, behavior: 'smooth' });
    setTimeout(function () {
        cta.classList.add('shaker');
        setTimeout(function () { cta.classList.remove('shaker'); }, 1000);
    }, 400);
}
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-expandable]').forEach(function (btn) {
        var id = btn.getAttribute('data-expandable');
        var desc = document.getElementById(id);
        if (desc && desc.scrollHeight <= desc.clientHeight) {
            btn.style.display = 'none';
        }
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.section__blur, .sidebar-section__blur').forEach(function (el) {
        el.addEventListener('click', scrollToCtaAndShake);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.mini-modal-trigger').forEach(function (trigger) {
        trigger.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            if (activeMiniModal && activeMiniModal.parentElement === trigger) {
                closeMiniModal();
            } else {
                openMiniModal(trigger);
            }
        });
    });
});
</script>
</script>
